news.headline_zh: 登革病毒本期公共卫生新闻动态
news.lead_zh: 本期登革病毒新闻集中呈现以下动态。
key_findings_zh: 皮尼拉斯县为应对登革热宣布了本地紧急状态,并免除居民轮胎处置费用以帮助减少其传播。该事件基于官方声明确认。 [news-b357ee1d5385e21f]
在古吉拉特邦报告了一次登革热暴发,数千人感染了该病毒,一名儿童死亡。文章讨论了该病毒的传播、进化及其对公共卫生的影响,包括Aedes aegypti蚊子的作用以及木瓜叶汁作为疗法未被证实有效。 [news-330e69c403eb7519]
佛罗里达州报告了暴发,当局宣布了局部紧急状态。此次暴发包括本地获得和旅行相关病例,并确认了一例罕见死亡(N1,N3,N5,N7,N9). [news-ddfb79c1c4c65d7f]

news.lead_en: This reporting window highlights the following Dengue virus news developments.
key_findings_en: Pinellas County declared a State of Local Emergency for dengue fever and waived the residential tire disposal fee to help reduce its spread. The event is confirmed based on the official declaration. [news-b357ee1d5385e21f]
A dengue outbreak has been reported in Gujarat, with thousands of people contracting the disease and one child reportedly dying. [news-330e69c403eb7519]

An outbreak of dengue fever was reported in Florida, with authorities declaring local states of emergency. The outbreak includes both locally acquired and travel-associated cases, and a rare death was confirmed (N1, N3, N5, N7, N9). [news-ddfb79c1c4c65d7f]

papers.title: Divergent mechanistic reliance on the phosphatidylinositol 4-kinase (PI4K)/oxysterol-binding protein (OSBP) axis during Zika virus versus dengue virus and West Nile virus replication organelle biogenesis.
papers.abstract: Positive-strand RNA viruses remodel host endoplasmic reticulum (ER) membranes into replication organelles (ROs) that support genome replication. Members of the genus Orthoflavivirus exploit host lipid pathways, particularly the phosphatidylinositol 4-kinase (PI4K)-phosphatidylinositol 4-phosphate (PI4P)-oxysterol-binding protein (OSBP) axis, yet they display marked mechanistic divergence. Specifically, it raised a central and unresolved question: is local PI4P enrichment an indispensable determining factor for viral vesicle biogenesis, or is it merely a contributing factor to a more fundamental, underlying mechanical requirement for high membrane curvature? Zika virus (ZIKV) shows strong dependence on PI4P enrichment. ZIKV nonstructural protein 1 (NS1) binds negatively charged lipids, including PI4P, via a positively charged membrane-binding surface that includes Arg31. This interaction supports NS1-mediated ER remodeling and subsequent OSBP-mediated cholesterol delivery. In contrast, dengue virus (DENV) and West Nile virus (WNV) largely bypass strict PI4P dependence. Their RO biogenesis relies more heavily on viral membrane proteins (NS4A/NS4B), host reticulon RTN3.1A, alternative lipid-shape remodeling (including phospholipase A2-generated lysophosphatidylcholine in WNV, sterol availability, and fatty-acid synthesis. Beyond the PI4P-OSBP axis, virus-specific exploitation of lipid peroxidation (ALOX12 pathway), cholesteryl-ester-enriched lipid droplets (via SOAT1/SOAT2), nuclear lipid droplets, and glycerophospholipid/ceramide remodeling further differentiates these viruses. These distinctions have direct implications for host-targeted antivirals. PI4K and OSBP inhibitors show preferential activity against ZIKV, whereas SOAT1/2 inhibition exhibits broader anti-orthoflaviviral potential, and other targets (FASN, NAAA, ALOX12) display virus-weighted efficacy. Recognition of this mechanistic spectrum is essential for accurate interpretation of lipid-perturbation studies and for the rational design of broad-spectrum or virus-selective antiviral strategies.

papers.title_zh: 寨卡病毒与登革病毒及西尼罗病毒在复制细胞器生物发生过程中对磷脂酰肌醇4-激酶(PI4K)/氧化固醇结合蛋白(OSBP)轴依赖机制的差异
papers.source_body_en: Positive-strand RNA viruses remodel host endoplasmic reticulum (ER) membranes into replication organelles (ROs) that support genome replication. Members of the genus Orthoflavivirus exploit host lipid pathways, particularly the phosphatidylinositol 4-kinase (PI4K)-phosphatidylinositol 4-phosphate (PI4P)-oxysterol-binding protein (OSBP) axis, yet they display marked mechanistic divergence. Specifically, it raised a central and unresolved question: is local PI4P enrichment an indispensable determining factor for viral vesicle biogenesis, or is it merely a contributing factor to a more fundamental, underlying mechanical requirement for high membrane curvature? Zika virus (ZIKV) shows strong dependence on PI4P enrichment. ZIKV nonstructural protein 1 (NS1) binds negatively charged lipids, including PI4P, via a positively charged membrane-binding surface that includes Arg31. This interaction supports NS1-mediated ER remodeling and subsequent OSBP-mediated cholesterol delivery. In contrast, dengue virus (DENV) and West Nile virus (WNV) largely bypass strict PI4P dependence. Their RO biogenesis relies more heavily on viral membrane proteins (NS4A/NS4B), host reticulon RTN3.1A, alternative lipid-shape remodeling (including phospholipase A2-generated lysophosphatidylcholine in WNV, sterol availability, and fatty-acid synthesis. Beyond the PI4P-OSBP axis, virus-specific exploitation of lipid peroxidation (ALOX12 pathway), cholesteryl-ester-enriched lipid droplets (via SOAT1/SOAT2), nuclear lipid droplets, and glycerophospholipid/ceramide remodeling further differentiates these viruses. These distinctions have direct implications for host-targeted antivirals. PI4K and OSBP inhibitors show preferential activity against ZIKV, whereas SOAT1/2 inhibition exhibits broader anti-orthoflaviviral potential, and other targets (FASN, NAAA, ALOX12) display virus-weighted efficacy. Recognition of this mechanistic spectrum is essential for accurate interpretation of lipid-perturbation studies and for the rational design of broad-spectrum or virus-selective antiviral strategies.
papers.abstract_zh: 正链RNA病毒通过重塑宿主内质网(ER)膜形成复制细胞器(ROs),以支持基因组的复制。该属的病毒利用宿主脂质通路,特别是磷脂酰肌醇4-激酶(PI4K)-磷脂酰肌醇4-磷酸(PI4P)-氧化固醇结合蛋白(OSBP)轴,但它们在机制上表现出显著的差异。具体而言,这提出了一个核心且未解决的问题:局部PI4P富集是否是病毒囊泡生物发生不可或缺的决定因素,还是仅仅是一个促进因素,用于满足更基础、更根本的高膜曲率机械需求?寨卡病毒(ZIKV)对PI4P富集表现出强烈的依赖性。ZIKV非结构蛋白1(NS1)通过包含Arg31的正电荷膜结合表面与带负电荷的脂质(包括PI4P)相互作用,这种相互作用支持NS1介导的内质网重塑以及随后OSBP介导的胆固醇输送。相比之下,登革病毒(DENV)和西尼罗病毒(WNV)则主要绕过了严格的PI4P依赖。它们的RO生物发生更依赖于病毒膜蛋白(NS4A/NS4B)、宿主的网状蛋白RTN3.1A,以及替代的脂质形态重塑(包括WNV中由磷脂酶A2生成的溶血磷脂酰胆碱、固醇可用性以及脂肪酸合成)。除了PI4P-OSBP轴之外,病毒特异性地利用脂质过氧化(ALOX12通路)、富含胆固醇酯的脂滴(通过SOAT1/SOAT2)、核脂滴以及甘油磷脂/鞘脂重塑,进一步区分了这些病毒。这些差异对针对宿主的抗病毒药物具有直接的临床意义。PI4K和OSBP抑制剂对ZIKV表现出选择性活性,而SOAT1/2抑制则展现出更广泛的抗正黄病毒潜力,其他靶点(FASN、NAAA、ALOX12)则显示出针对不同病毒的疗效。认识到这种机制谱系对于准确解读脂质扰动研究以及合理设计广谱或病毒特异性抗病毒药物策略至关重要。

papers.title: Dengue Vaccines: Bridging Innovation and Public Health
papers.abstract: Dengue is among the fastest-growing mosquito-borne viral infections worldwide and continues to pose a major public health challenge because no approved antiviral treatment is available. As a result, vaccination has become a cornerstone of dengue prevention. Several vaccine candidates have progressed through clinical development; however, questions remain regarding their efficacy, long-term safety, and ability to provide consistent protection against all four dengue virus serotypes. Over the last five years, findings from phase II and phase III clinical trials, post-licensure safety monitoring, and real-world effectiveness studies have substantially advanced the understanding of vaccine performance and influenced both regulatory recommendations and future vaccine development strategies. Despite these advances, important immunological issues remain unresolved, including the induction of balanced and durable immunity against all serotypes, identification of reliable correlates of protection, and clarification of how age and pre-existing dengue immunity affect vaccine responses. Clinical studies have reported variable outcomes, with several vaccines offering moderate protection against symptomatic dengue while showing differences in efficacy among serotypes and lower effectiveness in individuals without prior dengue exposure. Consequently, vaccination policies have evolved toward more targeted approaches, including pre-vaccination serological testing in selected settings, preferential use among seropositive populations, and integration of immunization programs with vector control and disease surveillance measures. Current research is focused on developing next-generation vaccines that provide stronger tetravalent immune responses, longer-lasting protection, and improved safety for seronegative individuals. In parallel, innovative clinical trial methodologies and detailed immunological analyses are being employed to better define the mechanisms underlying protective immunity. This review summarizes recent clinical evidence, emerging immunological knowledge, and evolving public health policies to provide an updated assessment of dengue vaccines and to identify key research priorities for achieving safe, effective, and equitable dengue prevention through vaccination. Keywords: Immunity; Dengue-vaccine; Tetravalent; Antibody-dependent enhancement; Serostatus-dependent efficacy; Vaccine-effectiveness; Pre-vaccination screening

analysis.summary_en: This review focuses on dengue vaccines, examining their development, efficacy, and public health implications. Dengue, caused by four serotypes (DENV-1 to DENV-4), remains a significant global health challenge due to the lack of approved antiviral treatments. The review highlights the progress made in vaccine development through phase II and III trials, post-licensure monitoring, and real-world effectiveness studies. However, key unresolved issues include the induction of balanced immunity against all serotypes, identification of correlates of protection, and the impact of age and prior immunity on vaccine responses. The review also discusses the evolution of vaccination policies toward targeted strategies, such as pre-vaccination serological testing and integration with vector control. Research priorities include improving tetravalent immune responses, enhancing safety for seronegative individuals, and refining trial methodologies to better understand protective mechanisms.

papers.title: Unveiling the antiviral mechanism of A4S7: a synthetic antimicrobial peptide targeting dengue and other mosquito-borne enveloped virus infections
papers.abstract: Dengue virus (DENV), an enveloped mosquito-borne flavivirus, is the causative agent of dengue and prevalent in tropical and subtropical regions. Severe cases can progress to dengue hemorrhagic fever or shock syndrome, posing significant public health challenges. In the absence of specific antiviral drugs, antimicrobial peptides (AMPs) have emerged as promising therapeutic agents against DENV due to their broad-spectrum antibacterial and antiviral properties. This study investigated the synthetic AMP A4S7, which effectively inhibited DENV-2 RNA and protein expression and reduced viral progeny production at specified concentrations without exhibiting cytotoxicity in Vero cells. Time-of-addition assays indicated that A4S7 might exert antiviral effects during early stages of infection. Binding assays further demonstrated that A4S7 interfered with DENV-2 binding to cellular membrane receptors, supported by molecular docking and FOPPR analyses, which revealed a direct interaction between A4S7 and the DENV-2 envelope protein. Moreover, A4S7 displayed antiviral activity in DENV-2-infected human cell lines, including U2OS, HMC3, and IMR-32 cells. Notably, the α-helical structure of A4S7 was found to be crucial for its antiviral activity. Furthermore, combining A4S7 with late-stage inhibitors such as ivermectin or favipiravir resulted in superior antiviral efficacy compared with their respective monotherapies. Importantly, A4S7 also exhibited antiviral activity against other enveloped viruses, including Zika virus (ZIKV) and Sindbis virus (SINV), but showed no inhibitory effects against non-enveloped viruses such as enterovirus 71 (EV71) and adenovirus. These findings underscore the potential of A4S7 as a promising candidate for the treatment of dengue and other enveloped viral infections.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to investigate the antiviral mechanism of the synthetic antimicrobial peptide A4S7 against dengue virus (DENV) and other enveloped viruses, addressing the need for effective antiviral therapies in the absence of specific drugs.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study utilized Vero cells and human cell lines (U2OS, HMC3, and IMR-32) to evaluate the antiviral effects of A4S7 against DENV-2 and other enveloped viruses, including Zika virus (ZIKV) and Sindbis virus (SINV).
analysis.methods: A4S7 was tested for its ability to inhibit DENV-2 RNA and protein expression, reduce viral progeny production, and interfere with DENV-2 binding to cellular membrane receptors. Molecular docking and FOPPR analyses were employed to understand the interaction between A4S7 and the DENV-2 envelope protein.
analysis.main_results: A4S7 effectively inhibited DENV-2 RNA and protein expression and reduced viral progeny production without cytotoxicity in Vero cells. It also displayed antiviral activity in human cell lines and showed no inhibitory effects against non-enveloped viruses such as enterovirus 71 (EV71) and adenovirus.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The study interpreted that A4S7 might exert antiviral effects during early stages of infection and that its α-helical structure is crucial for its antiviral activity. Combining A4S7 with late-stage inhibitors like ivermectin or favipiravir resulted in superior antiviral efficacy.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings suggest that A4S7 has potential as a promising candidate for the treatment of dengue and other enveloped viral infections, highlighting its broad-spectrum antiviral activity.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study's limitations include the absence of randomized controlled trials and the need for further validation in clinical settings. The evidence strength is moderate due to the in vitro nature of the experiments.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigated the antiviral mechanism of A4S7 against dengue virus and other enveloped viruses, demonstrating its effectiveness in inhibiting DENV-2 RNA and protein expression without cytotoxicity. The α-helical structure of A4S7 is crucial for its antiviral activity, and combining it with late-stage inhibitors enhances efficacy.

elements_en.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to investigate the antiviral mechanism of the synthetic antimicrobial peptide A4S7 against dengue virus (DENV) and other enveloped viruses, addressing the need for effective antiviral therapies in the absence of specific drugs.
elements_en.study_design_and_population: The study utilized Vero cells and human cell lines (U2OS, HMC3, and IMR-32) to evaluate the antiviral effects of A4S7 against DENV-2 and other enveloped viruses, including Zika virus (ZIKV) and Sindbis virus (SINV).
elements_en.methods: A4S7 was tested for its ability to inhibit DENV-2 RNA and protein expression, reduce viral progeny production, and interfere with DENV-2 binding to cellular membrane receptors. Molecular docking and FOPPR analyses were employed to understand the interaction between A4S7 and the DENV-2 envelope protein.
elements_en.main_results: A4S7 effectively inhibited DENV-2 RNA and protein expression and reduced viral progeny production without cytotoxicity in Vero cells. It also displayed antiviral activity in human cell lines and showed no inhibitory effects against non-enveloped viruses such as enterovirus 71 (EV71) and adenovirus.
elements_en.interpretation_and_novelty: The study interpreted that A4S7 might exert antiviral effects during early stages of infection and that its α-helical structure is crucial for its antiviral activity. Combining A4S7 with late-stage inhibitors like ivermectin or favipiravir resulted in superior antiviral efficacy.
elements_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings suggest that A4S7 has potential as a promising candidate for the treatment of dengue and other enveloped viral infections, highlighting its broad-spectrum antiviral activity.
elements_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study's limitations include the absence of randomized controlled trials and the need for further validation in clinical settings. The evidence strength is moderate due to the in vitro nature of the experiments.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在探讨合成抗菌肽A4S7对登革病毒(DENV)及其他包膜病毒的抗病毒药物机制,以应对在缺乏特定药物的情况下对有效抗病毒药物治疗的需求。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究使用Vero细胞和人类细胞系(U2OS、HMC3和IMR-32)来评估A4S7对DENV-2及其他包膜病毒(包括寨卡病毒ZIKV和辛德比斯病毒SINV)的抗病毒药物效果。
elements_zh.methods: 测试A4S7对DENV-2 RNA和蛋白质表达的抑制能力,减少病毒子代的产生,并干扰DENV-2与细胞膜受体的结合。采用分子对接和FOPPR分析来理解A4S7与DENV-2包膜蛋白之间的相互作用。
elements_zh.main_results: A4S7在特定浓度下有效抑制了DENV-2的RNA和蛋白质表达,并减少了病毒子代的产生,且在Vero细胞中未表现出细胞毒性。它在人类细胞系中也表现出抗病毒药物活性,并且对非包膜病毒如肠病毒71(EV71)和腺病毒无抑制作用。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究认为,A4S7可能在感染早期阶段发挥抗病毒药物作用,且其α-螺旋结构对其抗病毒药物活性至关重要。将A4S7与晚期抑制剂如伊维菌素或法匹拉韦联合使用,其抗病毒药物效果优于单独使用这些药物。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现表明,A4S7具有作为登革热及其他包膜病毒感染治疗候选药物的潜力,突显了其广谱抗病毒药物活性。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究的局限性包括缺乏随机对照试验以及需要在临床环境中进一步验证。由于实验为体外实验,其证据强度中等。

papers.title_zh: 揭示A4S7的抗病毒药物机制:一种针对登革热及其他蚊媒包膜病毒感染的合成抗菌肽
papers.source_body_en: Dengue virus (DENV), an enveloped mosquito-borne flavivirus, is the causative agent of dengue and prevalent in tropical and subtropical regions. Severe cases can progress to dengue hemorrhagic fever or shock syndrome, posing significant public health challenges. In the absence of specific antiviral drugs, antimicrobial peptides (AMPs) have emerged as promising therapeutic agents against DENV due to their broad-spectrum antibacterial and antiviral properties. This study investigated the synthetic AMP A4S7, which effectively inhibited DENV-2 RNA and protein expression and reduced viral progeny production at specified concentrations without exhibiting cytotoxicity in Vero cells. Time-of-addition assays indicated that A4S7 might exert antiviral effects during early stages of infection. Binding assays further demonstrated that A4S7 interfered with DENV-2 binding to cellular membrane receptors, supported by molecular docking and FOPPR analyses, which revealed a direct interaction between A4S7 and the DENV-2 envelope protein. Moreover, A4S7 displayed antiviral activity in DENV-2-infected human cell lines, including U2OS, HMC3, and IMR-32 cells. Notably, the α-helical structure of A4S7 was found to be crucial for its antiviral activity. Furthermore, combining A4S7 with late-stage inhibitors such as ivermectin or favipiravir resulted in superior antiviral efficacy compared with their respective monotherapies. Importantly, A4S7 also exhibited antiviral activity against other enveloped viruses, including Zika virus (ZIKV) and Sindbis virus (SINV), but showed no inhibitory effects against non-enveloped viruses such as enterovirus 71 (EV71) and adenovirus. These findings underscore the potential of A4S7 as a promising candidate for the treatment of dengue and other enveloped viral infections.
papers.abstract_zh: 登革病毒(DENV)是一种包膜蚊媒黄病毒,是登革热的病原体,并在热带和亚热带地区广泛流行。严重病例可发展为登革热出血热或休克综合征,对公共卫生构成重大挑战。在缺乏特定抗病毒药物药物的情况下,抗菌肽(AMPs)因其广谱抗菌和抗病毒药物特性,已成为对抗DENV的有前景的治疗药物。本研究探讨了合成AMP A4S7,其在特定浓度下有效抑制了DENV-2的RNA和蛋白质表达,并减少了病毒子代的产生,且在Vero细胞中未表现出细胞毒性。时间添加实验表明,A4S7可能在感染早期阶段发挥抗病毒药物作用。结合实验进一步显示,A4S7干扰了DENV-2与细胞膜受体的结合,分子对接和FOPPR分析揭示了A4S7与DENV-2包膜蛋白之间存在直接相互作用。此外,A4S7在DENV-2感染的人类细胞系(包括U2OS、HMC3和IMR-32细胞)中也表现出抗病毒药物活性。值得注意的是,A4S7的α-螺旋结构对其抗病毒药物活性至关重要。此外,将A4S7与晚期抑制剂如伊维菌素或法匹拉韦联合使用,其抗病毒药物效果优于单独使用这些药物。重要的是,A4S7还对其他包膜病毒表现出抗病毒药物活性,包括寨卡病毒(ZIKV)和辛德比斯病毒(SINV),但对非包膜病毒如肠病毒71(EV71)和腺病毒则无抑制作用。这些发现突显了A4S7作为登革热及其他包膜病毒感染治疗候选药物的潜力。

papers.title: Early warning of serotype replacement, spatial risk redistribution, and shifting clinical phenotypes: Insights from the 2023-2025 dengue outbreak in Meta, Colombia.
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Dengue remains a major public health challenge in hyperendemic regions, where shifts in serotype circulation, spatial transmission patterns, and clinical presentation can significantly influence outbreak dynamics. Colombia has experienced intense dengue activity in recent years; however, integrated analyses combining virological, spatial, and clinical data remain limited. METHODS: A retrospective longitudinal observational study was conducted using routinely collected dengue surveillance data from the Department of Meta, Colombia, covering the period from January 2023 to September 2025. Confirmed dengue cases with viral isolation and serotype identification were included. Temporal trends, serotype replacement dynamics, municipal-level spatial redistribution patterns, and clinical characteristics were analyzed using laboratory-confirmed dengue cases. Multivariable logistic regression models were used to identify factors associated with dengue positivity overall and by serotype, while interannual variation was assessed to evaluate changes in transmission intensity and the spatial redistribution of dengue transmission risk. RESULTS: Marked serotype replacement was observed during the study period. DENV-2 predominated during the 2023 peak, followed by a decline and a sustained increase in DENV-3 and DENV-4 by 2025, while DENV-1 disappeared from recent records. Spatial analysis showed declining diagnostic positivity in historically hyperendemic municipalities and significant interannual increases in intermediate municipalities, indicating an epidemiological rebound outside major urban centers. Classical dengue symptoms, including headache, myalgia, and rash, were inversely associated with virological confirmation, whereas nonspecific neurological manifestations, such as somnolence and irritability, emerged as independent predictors. Severe thrombocytopenia remained strongly associated with infection, particularly in DENV-2 cases. CONCLUSIONS: The dengue outbreak in Meta (2023-2025) was characterized by dynamic serotype replacement, spatial redistribution of transmission risk, and changing clinical presentations. The rapid emergence of DENV-4 in 2025 serves as an early warning of serotype replacement and underscores the need to update clinical screening protocols to include nonspecific neurological manifestations. Strengthening decentralized laboratory networks and closing surveillance gaps in low-endemicity areas are strategic priorities to improve early detection and outbreak control in hyperendemic regions.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 登革热仍然是高度流行地区的主要公共卫生挑战,其中血清型传播模式、空间传播分布和临床表现的变化可能显著影响暴发动态。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究使用Meta地区2023年1月至2025年9月期间常规收集的登革病毒监测数据,进行回顾性纵向观察研究。纳入了具有病毒分离和血清型鉴定的确认登革热病例。
elements_zh.methods: 利用实验室确认的登革热病例分析了时间趋势、血清型替代动态、市镇层面的空间风险重新分布模式以及临床特征。采用多变量逻辑回归模型识别与登革热阳性总体及各血清型相关的因素,同时评估年度间变化以评估传播强度的变化和登革病毒传播风险的空间重新分布。
elements_zh.main_results: 在研究期间观察到显著的血清型替代现象。2023年高峰期DENV-2占主导地位,随后到2025年DENV-3和DENV-4出现下降并持续上升,而DENV-1则从近期记录中消失。空间分析显示,在历史上高度流行的市镇中诊断阳性率下降,而在中间市镇中年度间显著上升,表明在主要城市中心之外出现了流行病学反弹。经典登革热症状,如头痛、肌肉痛和皮疹,与病毒学确认呈负相关,而非特异性神经症状,如嗜睡和易激惹,成为独立预测因素。严重的血小板减少症仍与感染密切相关,尤其是在DENV-2病例中。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: Meta地区2023-2025年的登革病毒暴发表现出动态的血清型替代、传播风险的空间重新分布以及临床表现的变化。

papers.title_zh: 早期预警:血清型替代、空间风险重新分布和临床表型变化:来自Meta地区2023-2025年登革病毒暴发的见解。
papers.source_body_en: BACKGROUND: Dengue remains a major public health challenge in hyperendemic regions, where shifts in serotype circulation, spatial transmission patterns, and clinical presentation can significantly influence outbreak dynamics. Colombia has experienced intense dengue activity in recent years; however, integrated analyses combining virological, spatial, and clinical data remain limited. METHODS: A retrospective longitudinal observational study was conducted using routinely collected dengue surveillance data from the Department of Meta, Colombia, covering the period from January 2023 to September 2025. Confirmed dengue cases with viral isolation and serotype identification were included. Temporal trends, serotype replacement dynamics, municipal-level spatial redistribution patterns, and clinical characteristics were analyzed using laboratory-confirmed dengue cases. Multivariable logistic regression models were used to identify factors associated with dengue positivity overall and by serotype, while interannual variation was assessed to evaluate changes in transmission intensity and the spatial redistribution of dengue transmission risk. RESULTS: Marked serotype replacement was observed during the study period. DENV-2 predominated during the 2023 peak, followed by a decline and a sustained increase in DENV-3 and DENV-4 by 2025, while DENV-1 disappeared from recent records. Spatial analysis showed declining diagnostic positivity in historically hyperendemic municipalities and significant interannual increases in intermediate municipalities, indicating an epidemiological rebound outside major urban centers. Classical dengue symptoms, including headache, myalgia, and rash, were inversely associated with virological confirmation, whereas nonspecific neurological manifestations, such as somnolence and irritability, emerged as independent predictors. Severe thrombocytopenia remained strongly associated with infection, particularly in DENV-2 cases. CONCLUSIONS: The dengue outbreak in Meta (2023-2025) was characterized by dynamic serotype replacement, spatial redistribution of transmission risk, and changing clinical presentations. The rapid emergence of DENV-4 in 2025 serves as an early warning of serotype replacement and underscores the need to update clinical screening protocols to include nonspecific neurological manifestations. Strengthening decentralized laboratory networks and closing surveillance gaps in low-endemicity areas are strategic priorities to improve early detection and outbreak control in hyperendemic regions.
papers.abstract_zh: 背景:登革热仍然是高度流行地区的主要公共卫生挑战,其中血清型传播模式、空间传播分布和临床表现的变化可能显著影响暴发动态。近年来,哥伦比亚Meta地区经历了强烈的登革热活动;然而,结合病毒学、空间和临床数据的综合分析仍然有限。方法:本研究使用Meta地区2023年1月至2025年9月期间常规收集的登革病毒监测数据,进行回顾性纵向观察研究。纳入了具有病毒分离和血清型鉴定的确认登革热病例。利用实验室确认的登革热病例分析了时间趋势、血清型替代动态、市镇层面的空间风险重新分布模式以及临床特征。采用多变量逻辑回归模型识别与登革热阳性总体及各血清型相关的因素,同时评估年度间变化以评估传播强度的变化和登革病毒传播风险的空间重新分布。结果:在研究期间观察到显著的血清型替代现象。2023年高峰期DENV-2占主导地位,随后到2025年DENV-3和DENV-4出现下降并持续上升,而DENV-1则从近期记录中消失。空间分析显示,在历史上高度流行的市镇中诊断阳性率下降,而在中间市镇中年度间显著上升,表明在主要城市中心之外出现了流行病学反弹。经典登革热症状,如头痛、肌肉痛和皮疹,与病毒学确认呈负相关,而非特异性神经症状,如嗜睡和易激惹,成为独立预测因素。严重的血小板减少症仍与感染密切相关,尤其是在DENV-2病例中。结论:Meta地区2023-2025年的登革病毒暴发表现出动态的血清型替代、传播风险的空间重新分布以及临床表现的变化。2025年DENV-4的快速出现为血清型替代提供了早期预警,并强调了更新临床筛查协议以纳入非特异性神经症状的必要性。加强分散式实验室网络并在低流行地区填补监测缺口是提高高度流行地区早期检测和暴发控制的战略优先事项。

papers.title: Computational Insights Into the Conformational Dynamics of the Dengue Virus Capsid Protein
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT The Dengue virus (DENV) capsid protein plays an important role in the viral lifecycle, including encapsidation of the genome, recruitment of lipid droplets, and assembly of particles. Capsid protein includes a hydrophobic pocket, which plays a central role in these functions and switches between closed and open conformations. This work studies the conformational change pathway of the capsid protein, specifically how the molecular mechanisms controlling the opening and closing of the hydrophobic pocket are controlled. By using a combination of different types of molecular dynamics simulations and enhanced sampling methods, we share insights on the structural rearrangements that play a crucial role in governing these transitions. Our results show that lipid binding modulates the accessibility of the hydrophobic pocket through environmental cues. In the open conformation, the pocket is involved in the interaction with lipids, stabilization of capsid dimers, and the promotion of immature virus assembly. Conversely, the closed conformation protects the hydrophobic pocket from the surrounding aqueous media as also preventing premature interactions in the solution phase that might disrupt protein stability. Such insights allow a deep understanding of capsid protein's conformational dynamics and represent a promising set of potent targets for antiviral strategies aiming to interfere with its functional transitions.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to understand the molecular mechanisms controlling the conformational changes of the Dengue virus capsid protein, particularly the opening and closing of its hydrophobic pocket, which is critical for its function in the viral lifecycle.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study employed computational methods to investigate the conformational dynamics of the Dengue virus capsid protein, focusing on its structural rearrangements and interactions with lipids.
analysis.methods: The researchers used molecular dynamics simulations and enhanced sampling techniques to analyze the structural transitions of the capsid protein and the role of lipid binding in modulating the hydrophobic pocket's accessibility.
analysis.main_results: The findings revealed that lipid binding influences the accessibility of the hydrophobic pocket through environmental cues, and the open conformation facilitates interactions with lipids, capsid dimer stabilization, and immature virus assembly.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted their results as providing a deeper understanding of the capsid protein's conformational dynamics, highlighting its functional transitions and suggesting potential targets for antiviral strategies.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These insights contribute to the development of antiviral strategies targeting the capsid protein's conformational changes, which could aid in preventing or treating Dengue virus infections.

analysis.summary_en: This study explores the conformational dynamics of the Dengue virus capsid protein, focusing on the hydrophobic pocket's role in the viral lifecycle. Using molecular dynamics simulations and enhanced sampling methods, the researchers identified how lipid binding modulates the pocket's accessibility, influencing interactions with lipids, capsid dimer stabilization, and immature virus assembly. The findings offer a deeper understanding of the capsid protein's functional transitions and suggest potential targets for antiviral strategies. While the study relies on computational models, the evidence is robust and provides valuable insights into the structural mechanisms of the capsid protein. The results have implications for the development of therapies targeting Dengue virus, but further experimental validation is needed to confirm these findings in biological systems.

papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 登革病毒(登革病毒)衣壳蛋白在病毒生命周期中起着重要作用,包括封装基因组、招募脂滴以及颗粒组装。衣壳蛋白包含一个疏水性口袋,该口袋在这些功能中起核心作用,并在闭合和开放构象之间切换。本研究探讨了衣壳蛋白的构象变化路径,特别是控制其疏水性口袋开闭的分子机制。通过结合不同类型分子动力学模拟和增强采样方法,我们分享了关于在调控这些转变中起关键作用的结构重排的见解。研究结果表明,脂质结合通过环境信号调节疏水性口袋的可接近性。在开放构象中,该口袋参与与脂质的相互作用、衣壳二聚体的稳定以及未成熟病毒的组装。相反,闭合构象保护疏水性口袋免受周围水性环境的影响,并防止溶液相中可能破坏蛋白质稳定性的过早相互作用。这些见解有助于深入理解衣壳蛋白的构象动态,并代表了针对抗病毒药物策略干扰其功能转变的有前景的潜在靶点。

papers.title: Assessment of the persistence and recovery of dengue virus RNA in urban wastewater: implications for Wastewater-Based Epidemiology.
papers.abstract: Dengue virus (DENV) poses a growing global public health threat due to increasingly frequent and severe outbreaks. Moreover, epidemiological surveillance systems have limitations in the timely detection of outbreaks, highlighting the need for complementary tools such as Wastewater-Based Epidemiology (WBE). This study aimed to generate further information on the persistence and recovery of DENV RNA in urban wastewater to support its monitoring through WBE. Two experiments were conducted. In Experiment 1, the persistence of DENV RNA in urban wastewater incubated at 4, 25, and 35°C for 21 days was evaluated. A negative binomial mixed-effects regression model estimated temperature-specific decay coefficients of -0.67 (95 % confidence interval (CI): -0.74--0.59), -1.25 (95 % CI: -1.32--1.17), and -1.31 (95 % CI: -1.37--1.23) at 4, 25, and 35°C, respectively. The corresponding times required for a 90 % reduction in genomic copies concentration were 30.1 (95 % CI: 20.7-48.1), 5.3 (95 % CI: 4.7-6.1), and 4.8 (95 % CI: 4.3-5.4) days. In Experiment 2, the performance of four recovery methods was compared. Ultrafiltration showed the highest recovery efficacy (61 ± 8 %), followed by direct analysis (42 ± 10 %) and polyethylene glycol precipitation (7 ± 4 %). Skimmed milk flocculation yielded results below the limit of detection. In conclusion, DENV RNA persisted in urban wastewater for several days at environmentally relevant temperatures, and ultrafiltration achieved the highest recovery efficacy among the methods evaluated, supporting the application of WBE as a community surveillance tool for DENV.

papers.title: Changes in Dengue Epidemiology in China Before, During, and After COVID-19 2015-2024: A Retrospective National Surveillance and Spatiotemporal Study.
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Dengue remains a major mosquito-borne disease in China. The COVID-19 pandemic and associated non-pharmaceutical interventions (NPIs) profoundly altered human mobility and public health responses, potentially reshaping dengue transmission dynamics. However, comprehensive nationwide evidence on their long-term epidemiological impact is limited. OBJECTIVE: This study aimed to evaluate changes in dengue epidemiology in China before, during, and after the COVID-19 pandemic, with a focus on temporal periodicity, importation and indigenous transmission, counterfactual deviations from pre-pandemic trends, and spatial risk redistribution. METHODS: We conducted a nationwide retrospective spatiotemporal study using reported dengue cases in China from 2015 to 2024. Epidemiological characteristics were compared across pre-pandemic, pandemic, and post-pandemic phases. Morlet wavelet analysis was used to assess temporal periodicity. A SARIMA model fitted to pre-pandemic data generated counterfactual forecasts for 2020-2024. Spatial patterns were evaluated using provincial incidence mapping, Global Moran's I, and Local Indicators of Spatial Association. RESULTS: A total of 87 182 dengue cases were reported, with major peaks in 2019 and 2024. Imported cases declined sharply during 2020-2022 and rebounded after 2023, whereas indigenous transmission became increasingly dominant. Annual periodicity weakened during the pandemic but re-emerged after 2023. Observed incidence during 2020-2022 was frequently below counterfactual expectations, while substantial positive deviations appeared from mid-2023 and intensified in 2024. Post-pandemic dengue risk re-emerged in South and Southwest China and expanded inland, with weaker provincial clustering. CONCLUSIONS: COVID-19 and related NPIs substantially reshaped dengue epidemiology in China, suppressing transmission during 2020-2022 but followed by a marked post-pandemic resurgence, increasing indigenous transmission, disrupted but re-emerging seasonality, and broader inland spread.

analysis.summary_en: This study examines changes in dengue epidemiology in China from 2015 to 2024, focusing on the impact of the COVID-19 pandemic and associated interventions. It reveals a sharp decline in imported cases and a rise in indigenous transmission during the pandemic, followed by a resurgence post-pandemic. The research highlights the disruption of annual periodicity and the expansion of dengue risk inland. These findings underscore the need for adaptive public health strategies to address evolving dengue dynamics. The study uses a spatiotemporal approach, including Morlet wavelet analysis and SARIMA modeling, to assess trends and deviations. While the evidence is moderate due to reliance on reported data, the results provide important insights into how pandemic-related measures have influenced dengue transmission patterns.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 登革热仍然是中国主要的蚊媒传染病。然而,关于其长期流行病学影响的全国性证据仍有限。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 我们使用2015年至2024年中国报告的登革热病例,开展了一项全国范围的回顾性时空研究。比较了疫情前、疫情期间和疫情后各阶段的流行病学特征。
elements_zh.methods: 采用Morlet小波分析评估时间周期性。基于疫情前数据拟合的SARIMA模型生成了2020-2024年的反事实预测。通过省级发病率地图、全球Moran's I指数和局部空间关联指标评估空间模式。
elements_zh.main_results: 共报告了87,182例登革热病例,主要高峰出现在2019年和2024年。2020年至2022年期间输入病例显著下降,但在2023年后反弹,而本土传播则变得越来越主导。疫情期间年度周期性减弱,但在2023年后重新出现。2020年至2022年期间观察到的发病率经常低于反事实预期,而从2023年中期开始出现显著的正向偏离,并在2024年加剧。疫情后,登革热风险重新出现在中国南方和西南地区,并向内陆扩展,省级聚集性减弱。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: COVID-19 and related NPIs substantially reshaped dengue epidemiology in China, suppressing transmission during 2020-2022 but followed by a marked post-pandemic resurgence, increasing indigenous transmission, disrupted but re-emerging seasonality, and broader inland spread.
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可以谨慎地用于指导中国登革热的监测策略、风险评估和公共卫生干预措施,强调需要采取适应性措施以应对疫情后不断变化的传播动态。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究依赖于报告的登革热病例,可能存在漏报或监测实践变化的问题。证据强度中等,因为其基于观察性数据和反事实建模。

CONCLUSIONS: COVID-19 and related NPIs substantially reshaped dengue epidemiology in China, suppressing transmission during 2020-2022 but followed by a marked post-pandemic resurgence, increasing indigenous transmission, disrupted but re-emerging seasonality, and broader inland spread.

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 登革热仍然是中国主要的蚊媒传染病。然而,关于其长期流行病学影响的全国性证据仍有限。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 我们使用2015年至2024年中国报告的登革热病例,开展了一项全国范围的回顾性时空研究。比较了疫情前、疫情期间和疫情后各阶段的流行病学特征。
analysis_zh.methods: 采用Morlet小波分析评估时间周期性。基于疫情前数据拟合的SARIMA模型生成了2020-2024年的反事实预测。通过省级发病率地图、全球Moran's I指数和局部空间关联指标评估空间模式。
analysis_zh.main_results: 共报告了87,182例登革热病例,主要高峰出现在2019年和2024年。2020年至2022年期间输入病例显著下降,但在2023年后反弹,而本土传播则变得越来越主导。疫情期间年度周期性减弱,但在2023年后重新出现。2020年至2022年期间观察到的发病率经常低于反事实预期,而从2023年中期开始出现显著的正向偏离,并在2024年加剧。疫情后,登革热风险重新出现在中国南方和西南地区,并向内陆扩展,省级聚集性减弱。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可以谨慎地用于指导中国登革热的监测策略、风险评估和公共卫生干预措施,强调需要采取适应性措施以应对疫情后不断变化的传播动态。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究依赖于报告的登革热病例,可能存在漏报或监测实践变化的问题。证据强度中等,因为其基于观察性数据和反事实建模。

papers.title: Vector Traits Shape Disease Persistence: A Predator–Prey Approach to Dengue
papers.abstract: Dengue continues to pose a major global threat, infecting nearly 390 million people annually. Recognizing the importance of studying vector biology and therein vector competence ( v c ), recent research focuses on mosquito parameters to inform transmission modeling and vector control strategies. This study models relationship between Aedes vectors and dengue pathogens, highlighting v c as a key driver of within-vector infection dynamics and endemic persistence. Using a predator-prey framework, we show that endemic conditions emerge naturally from the biological interplay between vector's strategies and pethogen pressure. We prove global stability of such conditions and determine thresholds of v c for three types of functional responses ( v c q ∗ , q = 0 , 1 , 2 ). Our results reveal that under tropical and subtropical environmental pressures, the innate immune system of vectors cannot offset high v c during endemic outbreaks, highlighting a fundamental biological trade-off: vectors can evolve increased transmission potential but cannot enhance immune capacity. This constraint defines the limits of their evolutionary response to pathogen-driven selection and drives instability in disease transmission dynamics.

papers.title_zh: 媒介特性塑造疾病持续性:利用捕食者-猎物方法研究登革热
papers.source_body_en: Dengue continues to pose a major global threat, infecting nearly 390 million people annually. Recognizing the importance of studying vector biology and therein vector competence ( v c ), recent research focuses on mosquito parameters to inform transmission modeling and vector control strategies. This study models relationship between Aedes vectors and dengue pathogens, highlighting v c as a key driver of within-vector infection dynamics and endemic persistence. Using a predator-prey framework, we show that endemic conditions emerge naturally from the biological interplay between vector's strategies and pethogen pressure. We prove global stability of such conditions and determine thresholds of v c for three types of functional responses ( v c q ∗ , q = 0 , 1 , 2 ). Our results reveal that under tropical and subtropical environmental pressures, the innate immune system of vectors cannot offset high v c during endemic outbreaks, highlighting a fundamental biological trade-off: vectors can evolve increased transmission potential but cannot enhance immune capacity. This constraint defines the limits of their evolutionary response to pathogen-driven selection and drives instability in disease transmission dynamics.

papers.title: Solanaceae-Derived Spirostane Saponins Inhibit Dengue Virus Replication and Viral Protein Expression and Exhibit Activity Against Multiple Arboviruses.
papers.abstract: Mosquito-borne arboviruses, including dengue virus (DENV), Zika virus (ZIKV), and chikungunya virus (CHIKV), represent a growing global health burden, yet no specific antiviral therapies are currently available for most of these infections. This unmet need highlights the importance of identifying novel antiviral compounds from biologically relevant sources such as plant-derived natural products. In this study, a bioactivity-guided approach was applied to methanolic extracts from eight Solanaceae species to identify compounds with antiviral activity against DENV-2 in Vero cells. Five extracts significantly reduced viral infectivity, with Solanum ovalifolium and Cestrum sp. achieving complete inhibition at non-cytotoxic concentrations. Subsequent fractionation and purification led to the isolation of four spirostane-type steroidal saponins, structurally characterized by UPLC-DAD-MS and 1D/2D NMR spectroscopy. Functional assays demonstrated that these compounds inhibit DENV replication, as evidenced by marked reductions in viral RNA levels, NS1 and NS3 protein expression, and infectious viral titers. Stage-specific analyses revealed that their antiviral activity is primarily associated with intracellular phases of the viral life cycle, consistent with inhibition of viral replication and/or protein processing. Molecular docking analyses supported these findings by predicting favorable interactions with key viral enzymes, particularly NS5 RNA-dependent RNA polymerase and NS3 helicase/protease. Importantly, the isolated compounds retained antiviral activity against ZIKV and CHIKV, indicating cross-arboviral efficacy. Together, these findings identify spirostane saponins as promising antiviral scaffolds and support their further development as broad-spectrum antiviral agents.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在从植物来源的天然产物中鉴定新型抗病毒药物化合物,以应对针对蚊媒虫媒病毒(包括登革病毒(DENV))的特异性抗病毒药物疗法的未满足需求。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 采用基于生物活性的筛选方法,对八种茄科植物的甲醇提取物进行分析,以鉴定具有抗病毒药物活性的化合物,针对Vero细胞中DENV-2的感染。
elements_zh.methods: 通过功能实验评估提取物的抗病毒药物活性,从而分离并表征四种螺甾烷型甾体皂苷。
elements_zh.main_results: 五种提取物显著降低了DENV-2的感染性,在非细胞毒性浓度下,Solanum ovalifolium和Cestrum sp.实现了完全抑制。分离出的化合物抑制了DENV的复制,这表现在病毒RNA水平、NS1和NS3蛋白表达以及传染性病毒滴度的明显下降。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果确定了螺甾烷皂苷作为有前景的抗病毒药物骨架,并支持其进一步开发为广谱抗病毒药物药物,对ZIKV和CHIKV具有跨属病毒的疗效。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可能有助于开发针对登革热和其他虫媒病毒的新抗病毒药物疗法,从而潜在地减少这些感染对全球公共卫生的负担。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究的局限性包括使用非随机的体外方法,这可能限制其结果的普遍适用性。由于研究结果尚处于初步阶段,证据强度中等。

Subsequent fractionation and purification led to the isolation of four spirostane-type steroidal saponins, structurally characterized by UPLC-DAD-MS and 1D/2D NMR spectroscopy. Functional assays demonstrated that these compounds inhibit DENV replication, as evidenced by marked reductions in viral RNA levels, NS1 and NS3 protein expression, and infectious viral titers. Stage-specific analyses revealed that their antiviral activity is primarily associated with intracellular phases of the viral life cycle, consistent with inhibition of viral replication and/or protein processing. Molecular docking analyses supported these findings by predicting favorable interactions with key viral enzymes, particularly NS5 RNA-dependent RNA polymerase and NS3 helicase/protease. Importantly, the isolated compounds retained antiviral activity against ZIKV and CHIKV, indicating cross-arboviral efficacy. Together, these findings identify spirostane saponins as promising antiviral scaffolds and support their further development as broad-spectrum antiviral agents.
papers.abstract_zh: 蚊媒虫媒病毒(包括登革病毒(DENV)、寨卡病毒(ZIKV)和基孔肯雅病毒(CHIKV))构成了日益增长的全球健康负担,但目前针对这些感染的特异性抗病毒药物疗法尚不普及。这种未满足的医疗需求凸显了从生物相关来源(如植物来源的天然产物)中识别新型抗病毒药物化合物的重要性。本研究采用基于生物活性的筛选方法,对八种茄科植物的甲醇提取物进行分析,以鉴定具有抗病毒药物活性的化合物,针对Vero细胞中DENV-2的感染。五种提取物显著降低了病毒的感染性,其中Solanum ovalifolium和Cestrum sp.在非细胞毒性浓度下实现了完全抑制。随后的分级和纯化过程分离出四种螺甾烷型甾体皂苷,其结构通过超高效液相色谱-二极管阵列检测-质谱(UPLC-DAD-MS)和一维/二维核磁共振(1D/2D NMR)光谱进行表征。功能实验表明,这些化合物抑制DENV复制,表现为病毒RNA水平、NS1和NS3蛋白表达以及传染性病毒滴度的显著下降。阶段特异性分析显示,其抗病毒药物活性主要与病毒生命周期的细胞内阶段相关,这与抑制病毒复制和/或蛋白质加工一致。分子对接分析支持这些发现,预测这些化合物与关键病毒酶(特别是NS5 RNA依赖性RNA聚合酶和NS3解旋酶/蛋白酶)具有有利的相互作用。重要的是,分离出的化合物对ZIKV和CHIKV也表现出抗病毒药物活性,表明其具有跨虫媒病毒的疗效。综上所述,这些发现表明螺甾烷皂苷是具有前景的抗病毒药物骨架,并支持其进一步开发为广谱抗病毒药物药物。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在从植物来源的天然产物中鉴定新型抗病毒药物化合物,以应对针对蚊媒虫媒病毒(包括登革病毒(DENV))的特异性抗病毒药物疗法的未满足需求。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 采用基于生物活性的筛选方法,对八种茄科植物的甲醇提取物进行分析,以鉴定具有抗病毒药物活性的化合物,针对Vero细胞中DENV-2的感染。
analysis_zh.methods: 通过功能实验评估提取物的抗病毒药物活性,从而分离并表征四种螺甾烷型甾体皂苷。
analysis_zh.main_results: 五种提取物显著降低了DENV-2的感染性,在非细胞毒性浓度下,Solanum ovalifolium和Cestrum sp.实现了完全抑制。分离出的化合物抑制了DENV的复制,这表现在病毒RNA水平、NS1和NS3蛋白表达以及传染性病毒滴度的明显下降。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果确定了螺甾烷皂苷作为有前景的抗病毒药物骨架,并支持其进一步开发为广谱抗病毒药物药物,对ZIKV和CHIKV具有跨属病毒的疗效。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可能有助于开发针对登革热和其他虫媒病毒的新抗病毒药物疗法,从而潜在地减少这些感染对全球公共卫生的负担。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究的局限性包括使用非随机的体外方法,这可能限制其结果的普遍适用性。由于研究结果尚处于初步阶段,证据强度中等。

papers.title: Optimising malaria and dengue case management through optimal diagnostic test allocation under budget constraints.
papers.abstract: In 2023 Burkina Faso faced hyperendemic Plasmodium falciparum malaria alongside the largest dengue epidemic recorded in West Africa. Both present as undifferentiated fever, and rapid diagnostic tests (RDTs) are the practical means of distinguishing them at the point of care. We formulate a 15-dimensional ordinary differential equation model coupling malaria and dengue transmission through two vector populations (Anopheles and Aedes), in which the two screening rates are control variables competing for a single pointwise-constrained diagnostic budget. We establish well-posedness, derive the basic and invasion reproduction numbers by the next-generation matrix method, and characterise the optimal controls via the Pontryagin Maximum Principle with the Karush-Kuhn-Tucker conditions, so that the allocation depends explicitly on the shadow price of the budget. A forward-backward sweep solves the boundary value problem, cross-validated against a sequential quadratic Hamiltonian scheme. Calibration to 104 weeks of Kadiogo Province surveillance attains coefficients of determination on the log(Y+1) scale of 0.82 (malaria) and 0.72 (dengue), with R 0 m =1.14 and R 0 d =1.57. The optimal dynamic allocation outperforms every heuristic tested, including two that are themselves time-varying: it reduces disease burden by 24.6% relative to standard malaria-first practice at the baseline budget and by over 32% at double the budget, and outperforms malaria-first in every one of 200 parameter draws under ± 30% uncertainty. The gain comes from the two epidemics peaking months apart, which in an epidemic year follows from malaria opening the season near its endemic level while dengue starts from a small seed.

papers.title_original: Optimising malaria and dengue case management through optimal diagnostic test allocation under budget constraints.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to address the challenge of distinguishing between malaria and dengue infections, which present similarly as undifferentiated fever, and to optimise diagnostic test allocation under budget constraints to improve case management.
analysis.study_design_and_population: A mathematical model was developed to simulate the transmission dynamics of malaria and dengue in Burkina Faso, focusing on the interaction between the two diseases and their respective vector populations (Anopheles and Aedes) over a 104-week surveillance period in Kadiogo Province.
analysis.methods: The study employed a 15-dimensional ordinary differential equation model, coupled with the Pontryagin Maximum Principle and Karush-Kuhn-Tucker conditions, to characterise optimal diagnostic test allocation. A forward-backward sweep method was used to solve the boundary value problem, cross-validated against a sequential quadratic Hamiltonian scheme.
analysis.main_results: The model achieved a coefficient of determination of 0.72 on the log(Y+1) scale for dengue, with an invasion reproduction number (R 0 d) of 1.57. The optimal dynamic allocation of diagnostic tests reduced disease burden by 24.6% at the baseline budget and by over 32% at double the budget, outperforming standard malaria-first practices in all 200 parameter draws under ± 30% uncertainty.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret that the optimal allocation strategy significantly improves disease burden reduction by leveraging the temporal separation of malaria and dengue epidemics, which allows for more efficient use of diagnostic resources.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings provide a framework for optimising diagnostic test allocation in regions with co-circulating malaria and dengue, potentially improving case management and resource efficiency in public health settings.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study relies on a mathematical model calibrated to surveillance data, which may not fully capture real-world complexities. The evidence is moderate in strength due to the model's assumptions and the limited scope of parameter uncertainty considered.

analysis.summary_en: This study addresses the challenge of distinguishing between malaria and dengue infections, which present similarly as undifferentiated fever, and aims to optimise diagnostic test allocation under budget constraints. A 15-dimensional ordinary differential equation model was developed to simulate the transmission dynamics of both diseases, incorporating vector populations and a constrained diagnostic budget. The model was calibrated to 104 weeks of surveillance data from Kadiogo Province, achieving a coefficient of determination of 0.72 for dengue. The optimal dynamic allocation of diagnostic tests reduced disease burden by 24.6% at the baseline budget and by over 32% at double the budget, outperforming standard malaria-first practices. The authors interpret that this improvement stems from the temporal separation of the two epidemics, allowing for more efficient resource use. The findings offer a framework for optimising diagnostic strategies in regions with co-circulating malaria and dengue, with moderate evidence strength due to model assumptions and limited parameter uncertainty analysis.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在解决疟疾和登革热感染在临床表现上相似(均表现为非特异性发热)的区分挑战,并在预算限制下优化诊断测试的分配,以改善病例管理。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 开发了一个数学模型,模拟布基纳法索疟疾和登革热的动态,重点关注这两种疾病及其各自的媒介种群(按蚊和伊蚊)在Kadiogo省104周期间的相互作用。
elements_zh.methods: 本研究采用了一个15维的常微分方程模型,结合庞特里亚金极大值原理和库什-库恩-塔克条件,以表征诊断测试的最优分配。通过前向-后向扫描方法解决了边界值问题,并通过顺序二次哈密顿方案进行了交叉验证。
elements_zh.main_results: 该模型在登革热的log(Y+1)尺度上实现了0.72的决定系数,其入侵繁殖数(R 0 d)为1.57。在基线预算下,诊断测试的最优动态分配减少了24.6%的疾病负担,在双倍预算下减少了超过32%的疾病负担,在±30%的不确定性范围内,所有200个参数抽样均优于标准的疟疾优先检测实践。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者解释认为,最优分配策略通过利用疟疾和登革热疫情在时间上的分离,显著提高了疾病负担的减少效果,从而实现了诊断资源的更高效利用。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果为在同时流行疟疾和登革热的地区优化诊断测试分配提供了框架,可能有助于改善病例管理和公共卫生资源的使用效率。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究依赖于校准到监测数据的数学模型,可能无法完全反映现实世界的复杂性。由于模型的假设和考虑的参数不确定性范围有限,其证据强度中等。

papers.title: Dengue in an era of hyperendemicity: clinical triage, case management, and primary care preparedness in resource-constrained settings: a narrative review
papers.abstract: Dengue is placing increasing pressure on frontline health services as recurrent transmission, co-circulating serotypes, and expanding outbreaks generate large volumes of clinically similar febrile illnesses. Although most infections remain uncomplicated, deterioration may occur rapidly around defervescence, creating a narrow window in which clinicians must distinguish patients suitable for outpatient care from those requiring observation, stabilization, or referral. This narrative review examines dengue management as a continuous clinical pathway linking early recognition, decision-relevant testing, dynamic triage, phase-specific care, vulnerability assessment, and primary care preparedness in resource-constrained settings. The evidence indicates that diagnostic confirmation and severity prediction are related but distinct tasks: laboratory testing can support diagnosis, but safe disposition depends on repeated assessment of illness day, hemodynamic status, perfusion, urine output, fluid balance, functional decline, and evolving clinical or laboratory trends. Outpatient management should therefore be treated as an active care pathway requiring structured reassessment, explicit safety netting, and feasible return arrangements, while intravenous fluid therapy should be individualized according to disease phase, treatment response, and risk of overload. Children, pregnant and postpartum patients, older adults, people with comorbidities, and those facing transport, communication, or referral barriers, require modified thresholds for observation and escalation. Primary care readiness should be judged by the reliable performance of essential functions, including structured triage, monitoring, patient communication, stabilization, referral coordination, and surveillance-linked surge response, rather than by the nominal availability of guidelines, training, diagnostics, or equipment. However, the evidence remains dominated by hospital-based studies from Asia and Latin America, with major gaps in primary care, Africa, rural settings, fragile systems, and humanitarian contexts. Therefore, the priority is to translate existing clinical guidance into a feasible, consistently delivered frontline pathway across both routine transmission and outbreak surges.

analysis.scope_and_question: This narrative review examines dengue virus infection and its clinical management in resource-constrained settings, focusing on how frontline health services can triage and manage patients across disease phases to prevent rapid deterioration.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: The authors conducted a narrative review of the literature, synthesizing evidence on dengue management pathways.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: Diagnostic confirmation and severity prediction are distinct tasks; safe disposition requires repeated assessment of clinical and laboratory trends, and outpatient care must be an active pathway with structured reassessment and individualized fluid therapy. Vulnerable populations need modified thresholds for observation and escalation.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: Existing evidence is largely hospital-based from Asia and Latin America, leaving major gaps in primary care, Africa, rural settings, fragile systems, and humanitarian contexts.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: Primary care readiness should be judged by reliable performance of essential functions—structured triage, monitoring, patient communication, stabilization, referral coordination, and surveillance-linked surge response—and by translating clinical guidance into a consistently delivered frontline pathway.

analysis.summary_en: The review focuses on dengue virus infection management in resource-constrained settings, outlining how frontline services can triage patients to prevent rapid deterioration. It is a narrative synthesis of existing literature. Key findings highlight that diagnostic confirmation and severity prediction are distinct, requiring repeated clinical assessment and individualized fluid therapy, with modified thresholds for vulnerable groups. Evidence gaps exist due to a predominance of hospital-based studies from Asia and Latin America, underscoring the need for primary care data from Africa, rural, fragile, and humanitarian contexts. Practical implications emphasize that primary care readiness hinges on reliable triage, monitoring, communication, stabilization, referral coordination, and surge response, and that clinical guidance must be translated into a consistently delivered frontline pathway.

analysis_en.scope_and_question: This narrative review examines dengue virus infection and its clinical management in resource-constrained settings, focusing on how frontline health services can triage and manage patients across disease phases to prevent rapid deterioration.
analysis_en.evidence_base_and_review_method: The authors conducted a narrative review of the literature, synthesizing evidence on dengue management pathways.
analysis_en.consensus_and_key_conclusions: Diagnostic confirmation and severity prediction are distinct tasks; safe disposition requires repeated assessment of clinical and laboratory trends, and outpatient care must be an active pathway with structured reassessment and individualized fluid therapy. Vulnerable populations need modified thresholds for observation and escalation.
analysis_en.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: Existing evidence is largely hospital-based from Asia and Latin America, leaving major gaps in primary care, Africa, rural settings, fragile systems, and humanitarian contexts.
analysis_en.research_and_practice_implications: Primary care readiness should be judged by reliable performance of essential functions—structured triage, monitoring, patient communication, stabilization, referral coordination, and surveillance-linked surge response—and by translating clinical guidance into a consistently delivered frontline pathway.

papers.title_zh: 在登革热高流行时代:资源匮乏地区临床分诊、病例管理及初级卫生保健准备:一项叙述性综述
papers.source_body_en: Dengue is placing increasing pressure on frontline health services as recurrent transmission, co-circulating serotypes, and expanding outbreaks generate large volumes of clinically similar febrile illnesses. Although most infections remain uncomplicated, deterioration may occur rapidly around defervescence, creating a narrow window in which clinicians must distinguish patients suitable for outpatient care from those requiring observation, stabilization, or referral. This narrative review examines dengue management as a continuous clinical pathway linking early recognition, decision-relevant testing, dynamic triage, phase-specific care, vulnerability assessment, and primary care preparedness in resource-constrained settings. The evidence indicates that diagnostic confirmation and severity prediction are related but distinct tasks: laboratory testing can support diagnosis, but safe disposition depends on repeated assessment of illness day, hemodynamic status, perfusion, urine output, fluid balance, functional decline, and evolving clinical or laboratory trends. Outpatient management should therefore be treated as an active care pathway requiring structured reassessment, explicit safety netting, and feasible return arrangements, while intravenous fluid therapy should be individualized according to disease phase, treatment response, and risk of overload. Children, pregnant and postpartum patients, older adults, people with comorbidities, and those facing transport, communication, or referral barriers, require modified thresholds for observation and escalation. Primary care readiness should be judged by the reliable performance of essential functions, including structured triage, monitoring, patient communication, stabilization, referral coordination, and surveillance-linked surge response, rather than by the nominal availability of guidelines, training, diagnostics, or equipment. However, the evidence remains dominated by hospital-based studies from Asia and Latin America, with major gaps in primary care, Africa, rural settings, fragile systems, and humanitarian contexts. Therefore, the priority is to translate existing clinical guidance into a feasible, consistently delivered frontline pathway across both routine transmission and outbreak surges.
papers.abstract_zh: 登革热正对一线卫生服务施加日益增加的压力,因为反复暴发、共循环的血清型以及扩展的传播范围导致大量临床相似的发热性疾病。尽管大多数感染仍为非复杂性,但退热前后可能迅速恶化,这为临床医生区分适合门诊治疗的患者和需要观察、稳定或转诊的患者创造了狭窄的时间窗口。本叙述性综述探讨了登革热管理作为一条连续的临床路径,涵盖早期识别、决策相关检测、动态分诊、疾病阶段特定护理、脆弱性评估以及资源匮乏地区的初级卫生保健准备。证据表明,诊断确认和严重程度预测是相关但不同的任务:实验室检测可以支持诊断,但安全处置依赖于对疾病天数、血流动力学状态、灌注情况、尿量、体液平衡、功能下降以及临床或实验室趋势的重复评估。因此,门诊管理应被视为一项主动的护理路径,需要结构化的重新评估、明确的安全网措施以及可行的返程安排,而静脉输液治疗则应根据疾病阶段、免疫应答及过载风险进行个体化调整。儿童、孕妇及产后患者、老年人、有合并症的患者以及面临交通、沟通或转诊障碍的人群,需要调整观察和升级的阈值。初级卫生保健的准备应通过关键功能的可靠执行来评估,包括结构化分诊、监测、患者沟通、稳定、转诊协调以及与基因组监测相关的突发情况应对,而不是仅仅依赖于指南、培训、诊断工具或设备的名义可用性。然而,现有证据主要来自亚洲和拉丁美洲的医院研究,存在关于初级卫生保健、非洲、农村地区、脆弱系统以及人道主义环境的重大空白。因此,优先事项是将现有的临床指导转化为在常规登革热暴发和基因组监测相关暴发中均可实施并一致提供的前线护理路径。

papers.title: Association of dengue severity with the serotype of infection: a systematic review and meta-analysis
papers.abstract: Background Dengue is a mosquito-borne infection caused by one of four dengue virus serotypes (DENV1-4) that circulates endemically across the tropics and subtropics. To date, there is contrasting evidence on the relationship between the serotype of infection and disease severity. Methods We conducted a systematic review (PROSPERO, CRD42023443101) and meta-analysis to examine the association between the serotype of symptomatic infections with severe disease while accounting for both prior exposure status and geographic region, with 18 severity defined by (i) the 1997 World Health Organization (WHO) guidelines, (ii) the 2009 WHO guidelines or (iii) hospitalisation. We searched the Global Health, Embase Classic + Embase, and Medline databases using Ovid for studies published up to 20 January 2025 and extracted case counts with matched serotype and severity information. We fitted generalised linear mixed models to estimate the proportions of severe cases, running independent analyses per severity definition, and stratifying by prior exposure-serotype combinations (e.g. primary DENV2) and geographic region (Asia versus Americas). Heterogeneity was assessed using the τ 26 and I metrics and risk of bias was assessed by adapting an established tool for risk of bias in prevalence studies. 28 Findings Our search yielded 4621 unique records, with 71 studies included for the meta-analysis. Methods We conducted a systematic review (PROSPERO, CRD42023443101) and meta-analysis to examine the association between the serotype of symptomatic infections with severe disease while accounting for both prior exposure status and geographic region, with 18 severity defined by (i) the 1997 World Health Organization (WHO) guidelines, (ii) the 2009 WHO guidelines or (iii) hospitalisation. We searched the Global Health, Embase Classic + Embase, and Medline databases using Ovid for studies published up to 20 January 2025 and extracted case counts with matched serotype and severity information. We fitted generalised linear mixed models to estimate the proportions of severe cases, running independent analyses per severity definition, and stratifying by prior exposure-serotype combinations (e.g. primary DENV2) and geographic region (Asia versus Americas). Heterogeneity was assessed using the τ 26 and I metrics and risk of bias was assessed by adapting an established tool for risk of bias in prevalence studies. 28 Findings Our search yielded 4621 unique records, with 71 studies included for the meta-analysis. We found that, on average, DENV3 in Asia resulted in the highest proportion of DHF/DSS (21·00% [95% CrI: 13·02 to 30·44%]) and hospitalised (22·00% [95% CrI: 0·88 to 75·31%]) cases among symptomatic primary infections, while also causing the highest proportion

papers.title_original: Association of dengue severity with the serotype of infection: a systematic review and meta-analysis

analysis.scope_and_question: This review examines the association between the serotype of dengue virus infection and disease severity, focusing on symptomatic primary infections and their outcomes, including severe dengue, dengue hemorrhagic fever, dengue shock syndrome, and hospitalisation. The central question is whether specific dengue virus serotypes are linked to higher severity of disease.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: The review conducted a systematic search of the Global Health, Embase Classic + Embase, and Medline databases using Ovid, including studies published up to 20 January 2025. The eligibility criteria included studies with matched serotype and severity information. A meta-analysis was performed using generalised linear mixed models, stratifying by prior exposure-serotype combinations and geographic region (Asia versus Americas). Heterogeneity was assessed using τ2 and I2 metrics, and risk of bias was evaluated using an adapted tool for prevalence studies.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: The meta-analysis found that DENV3 in Asia resulted in the highest proportion of dengue hemorrhagic fever/dengue shock syndrome (DHF/DSS) cases among symptomatic primary infections, with an average of 21·00% [95% CrI: 13·02 to 30·44%]. It also showed that DENV3 caused the highest proportion of hospitalised cases (22·00% [95% CrI: 0·88 to 75·31%]) among primary infections.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: There is contrasting evidence on the relationship between serotype and disease severity. The review highlights heterogeneity in findings and the need for further research to clarify the role of serotype in disease severity across different geographic regions and exposure statuses.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: Further research is needed to understand the mechanisms by which specific serotypes contribute to disease severity and to explore the impact of geographic region and prior exposure on outcomes. Surveillance and diagnostic efforts should consider serotype-specific patterns in disease severity to improve public health responses.

analysis.summary_en: This systematic review and meta-analysis investigate the association between dengue virus serotype and disease severity, focusing on symptomatic primary infections. The study included 71 studies from a search of Global Health, Embase Classic + Embase, and Medline databases up to 20 January 2025. The analysis used generalised linear mixed models to estimate severe case proportions, stratifying by serotype and geographic region. The findings suggest that DENV3 in Asia is associated with the highest proportion of severe dengue cases, including dengue hemorrhagic fever/dengue shock syndrome and hospitalisation. However, the review notes contrasting evidence and heterogeneity in results, highlighting the need for further research to clarify serotype-specific impacts on disease severity.

elements_zh.scope_and_question: 本综述探讨了感染血清型与疾病严重程度之间的关联,重点关注有症状的初次感染及其结果,包括登革热、登革出血热、登革休克综合征和住院情况。核心问题是特定血清型是否与更高的疾病严重程度相关。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 综述通过Ovid检索了Global Health、Embase Classic + Embase和Medline数据库,包括截至2025年1月20日发表的研究。纳入标准包括具有匹配血清型和严重程度信息的研究。采用广义线性混合模型进行了荟萃分析,并按先前暴露-血清型组合和地理区域(亚洲与美洲)进行分层。异质性通过τ2和I2指标进行评估,偏倚风险则通过修改后的适用于患病率研究的偏倚风险评估工具进行评估。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 荟萃分析发现,在亚洲地区,DENV3在有症状的初次感染中导致的登革出血热/登革休克综合征(DHF/DSS)病例比例最高,平均为21·00% [95% CrI: 13·02至30·44%]。它还表明,DENV3在初次感染中导致的住院病例比例最高,为22·00% [95% CrI: 0·88至75·31%]。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 关于血清型与疾病严重程度之间的关系存在相互矛盾的证据。综述强调了研究结果的异质性,并指出需要进一步研究以明确不同地理区域和暴露状态中血清型在疾病严重程度中的作用。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 需要进一步研究以了解特定血清型如何导致疾病严重程度,并探讨地理区域和先前暴露对结果的影响。监测和诊断工作应考虑疾病严重程度的血清型特异性模式,以提高公共卫生应对措施。

papers.title: The circSNX6 restricts dengue virus replication in association with PARP1 and ferroptosis
papers.abstract: Dengue virus (DENV) infection poses a persistent global health challenge with no specific antiviral therapy. Although circular RNAs (circRNAs) regulate antiviral immunity, their roles in DENV infection remain largely unexplored. Here, transcriptome sequencing of peripheral blood mononuclear cells (PBMCs) from dengue patients across disease phases and severities identified 15 circRNAs consistently dysregulated across all clinical stages, enriched in ferroptosis, glutathione metabolism, and endocytosis pathways. Among these, hsa_circ_0031607 (circSNX6) was the sole circRNA linked to all three pathways and was upregulated in both dengue patients and DENV2-infected human umbilical vein endothelial cells (HUVECs). circSNX6 overexpression suppressed DENV2 replication, whereas its knockdown enhanced viral propagation. Mechanistically, circSNX6 localized to the cytoplasm and interacted with PARP1. DENV2 infection induced partial PARP1 redistribution from nucleus to cytoplasm. circSNX6 suppressed PARP1 expression; its knockdown increased global PARylation, accompanied by enhanced NRF2 PARylation and altered TFR1 and GPX4 expression. In cultured cells, ferrostatin-1 reduced and erastin enhanced DENV2 replication; olaparib or ferrostatin-1 partially attenuated the proviral effects of circSNX6 knockdown, while erastin partially reversed the antiviral effect of circSNX6 overexpression. In mice, olaparib reduced serum and hepatic viral loads and attenuated hepatic pathology; ferrostatin-1 produced comparable effects, and erastin cotreatment partially diminished olaparib-mediated protection. Together, these results delineate the circRNA landscape across dengue disease progression and identify circSNX6 as a host factor that restricts DENV2 replication in part through suppression of the PARP1–ferroptosis axis.
papers.journal: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences

analysis.research_question_and_background: Dengue virus (DENV) infection poses a persistent global health challenge with no specific antiviral therapy. Although circular RNAs (circRNAs) regulate antiviral immunity, their roles in DENV infection remain largely unexplored.
analysis.study_design_and_population: Here, transcriptome sequencing of peripheral blood mononuclear cells (PBMCs) from dengue patients across disease phases and severities identified 15 circRNAs consistently dysregulated across all clinical stages, enriched in ferroptosis, glutathione metabolism, and endocytosis pathways.
analysis.methods: The study used transcriptome sequencing of PBMCs from dengue patients across disease phases and severities to identify circRNAs. It also included cultured cells and mice models to assess the effects of circSNX6 on DENV2 replication and related pathways.
analysis.main_results: Among the 15 circRNAs, hsa_circ_0031607 (circSNX6) was the sole circRNA linked to all three pathways and was upregulated in both dengue patients and DENV2-infected human umbilical vein endothelial cells (HUVECs). circSNX6 overexpression suppressed DENV2 replication, whereas its knockdown enhanced viral propagation.

analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These findings identify circSNX6 as a host factor that restricts DENV2 replication, offering potential insights into new therapeutic strategies targeting the PARP1–ferroptosis axis for dengue management.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited to abstract-level evidence, and the results are based on in vitro and in vivo models, which may not fully represent human disease complexity. The evidence is moderate in strength due to the absence of detailed clinical data.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates the role of circRNAs in dengue virus (DENV) infection, focusing on circSNX6. It identifies circSNX6 as a host factor that restricts DENV2 replication through interactions with PARP1 and modulation of the ferroptosis pathway. The research highlights potential therapeutic strategies targeting the PARP1–ferroptosis axis. However, the study is limited to abstract-level evidence and relies on in vitro and in vivo models, which may not fully capture human disease dynamics. The findings contribute to understanding the host-virus interaction in DENV infection and suggest new avenues for antiviral approaches.

papers.abstract_zh: 登革病毒(DENV)感染对全球健康构成持续挑战,目前尚无特定的抗病毒药物疗法。尽管环状RNA(circRNAs)调节抗病毒药物免疫,但它们在DENV感染中的作用仍 largely unexplored。在这里,通过对登革热患者不同疾病阶段和严重程度的外周血单核细胞(PBMCs)进行转录组测序,鉴定了15个在所有临床阶段中一致失调的circRNAs,这些circRNAs富集于铁死亡、谷胱甘肽代谢和内吞作用通路。其中,hsa_circ_0031607(circSNX6)是唯一与这三个通路相关联的circRNA,并且在登革热患者和DENV2感染的人脐静脉内皮细胞(HUVECs)中均被上调。circSNX6的过表达抑制了DENV2的复制,而其敲低则增强了病毒传播。机制上,circSNX6定位于细胞质并与PARP1相互作用。DENV2感染导致PARP1部分从细胞核转移到细胞质。circSNX6抑制了PARP1的表达;其敲低增加了全局的PARylation,伴随NRF2的PARylation增强以及TFR1和GPX4表达的改变。在培养的细胞中,ferrostatin-1减少了DENV2的复制,而erastin增强了DENV2的复制;olaparib或ferrostatin-1部分减弱了circSNX6敲低的促病毒作用,而erastin部分逆转了circSNX6过表达的抗病毒作用。在小鼠中,olaparib降低了血清和肝脏中的病毒载量,并减轻了肝脏病理;ferrostatin-1产生了类似的效果,而erastin联合治疗部分抵消了olaparib介导的保护作用。综上所述,这些结果描绘了circRNA在登革热疾病进展中的图谱,并确定了circSNX6作为限制DENV2复制的宿主因子,其作用部分通过抑制PARP1–铁死亡轴实现。

analysis_zh.methods: 本研究使用登革热患者不同疾病阶段和严重程度的外周血单核细胞(PBMCs)的转录组测序来鉴定circRNAs。此外,还使用了培养的细胞和小鼠模型来评估circSNX6对DENV2复制及相关通路的影响。
analysis_zh.main_results: 在15个circRNAs中,hsa_circ_0031607(circSNX6)是唯一与这三个通路相关联的circRNA,并且在登革热患者和DENV2感染的人脐静脉内皮细胞(HUVECs)中均被上调。circSNX6的过表达抑制了DENV2的复制,而其敲低则增强了病毒传播。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 机制上,circSNX6定位于细胞质并与PARP1相互作用。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现确定了circSNX6作为限制DENV2复制的宿主因子,为针对PARP1–铁死亡轴的新治疗策略提供了潜在的见解。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究仅基于摘要级别的证据,结果基于体外和体内模型,可能无法完全代表人类疾病的复杂性。由于缺乏详细的临床数据,证据强度中等。

papers.title: The capsid proteins of orthoflavivirus are interchangeable for West Nile virus assembly.
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Orthoflavivirus virions consist of an envelope enclosing a nucleocapsid core. A critical step in orthoflavivirus assembly is the encapsidation of genomic RNA by the capsid protein to form the nucleocapsid. However, the molecular details of this process remain poorly understood, particularly whether capsid proteins bind genomic RNA through specific interactions. Here, we utilized West Nile virus (WNV) and dengue virus (DENV) as model systems to investigate heterologous genome RNA encapsidation. Employing a chimeric virus strategy, we demonstrated that the DENV-2 capsid protein can package WNV genomic RNA if two critical elements are preserved: cis -acting sequences essential for RNA synthesis and the cleavage site required for capsid maturation. Furthermore, by decoupling the WNV cis -acting elements from the capsid-coding sequence and replacing the WNV capsid protein with orthologous capsid proteins from other orthoflaviviruses, we provide direct virological evidence that orthoflavivirus capsid proteins package genomic RNAs in a non-sequence-specific manner. These findings advance our mechanistic understanding of orthoflavivirus genome packaging. IMPORTANCE The encapsidation of genomic RNA by capsid proteins as the primary event in orthoflavivirus virion assembly is not well understood in current research; particularly, whether it involves specific packaging signals remains a question. The orthoflavivirus capsid protein plays a key role in both genome replication and viral particle assembly. Our comprehensive virological analyses reveal that orthoflavivirus capsid protein shows considerable interspecies packaging flexibility while critical replication and processing elements are preserved. These insights underscore a key aspect of orthoflavivirus biology: the conserved packaging function of capsid proteins across genus members is mediated by structural interactions, rather than sequence specificity.

papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 正黏液病毒属病毒由包膜包裹的核衣壳核心组成。正黏液病毒组装的关键步骤是衣壳蛋白将基因组RNA封装成核衣壳。然而,这一过程的分子细节仍不明确,特别是衣壳蛋白是否通过特异性相互作用结合基因组RNA。在此研究中,我们利用西尼罗病毒(WNV)和登革病毒(DENV)作为模型系统,研究异源基因组 RNA的封装。通过使用嵌合病毒策略,我们证明了当保留两个关键元件时,DENV-2衣壳蛋白可以包装WNV基因组RNA:cis-作用序列,对RNA合成至关重要,以及衣壳成熟所需的切割位点。此外,通过将WNV的cis-作用元件与衣壳编码序列分离,并用其他正黏液病毒属的同源衣壳蛋白替换WNV衣壳蛋白,我们提供了直接的病毒学证据,表明正黏液病毒属的衣壳蛋白以非序列特异性方式包装基因组RNA。这些发现推进了我们对正黏液病毒属基因组包装机制的理解。重要性 当前研究对正黏液病毒属病毒颗粒组装中衣壳蛋白封装基因组RNA这一主要事件的理解尚不充分,特别是是否涉及特异性包装信号仍是一个问题。正黏液病毒属的衣壳蛋白在基因组复制和病毒颗粒组装中起关键作用。我们的全面病毒学分析表明,正黏液病毒属的衣壳蛋白在不同物种间表现出显著的包装灵活性,同时关键的复制和加工元件得以保留。这些见解突显了正黏液病毒属生物学的一个关键方面:该属成员的衣壳蛋白在包装功能上的保守性是由结构相互作用而非序列特异性所介导的。

papers.title: Interferon gamma and inflammatory response genes by weighted gene co-expression network analysis reveal significant associations with severe dengue infection in India
papers.abstract: Objective Dengue virus, with four serotypes (DENV 1-4), is transmitted by Aedes aegypti . India carries 34% of global cases, yet studies to understand how the immune system reacts to dengue infection remain limited. Design This study uncovers early transcriptional signatures from whole blood of 112 NS1 positive hospital reported dengue patients and dissect biological processes linked to varying disease severities “with (WS ) and without (-WS ) warning signs”. Results Differential gene expression analysis showed suppressed innate response in WS patients, with downregulated cytokines ( CXCL8, CXCL16, CXCL2, IL1B) and disrupted platelet function. Upregulation was observed in genes related to glycosylation, nervous system, and metabolism. WGCNA module-trait analysis identified interferon response and inflammation as positively correlated with platelet count, highlighting key genes, IFI44L , IFI35 , OAS1 , HERC6 and SAMDL9 contributing to comparative severe outcomes. CTTN involved in maintenance of vascular permeability showed highest significant association with low platelet count. IFI44L emerged as a significant marker, showing highest transcript count difference between patients with platelet counts below 100 × 10ˆ9/L and those between 100-140 × 10ˆ9/L. Conclusion This study advances understanding of dengue infection and identifying probable clinical biomarkers at the initial phase of infection. These findings might hold potential for improving diagnostic and therapeutic strategies.
