analysis.research_question_and_background: This study aimed to understand the immune response to dengue infection and identify potential clinical biomarkers for severe disease. India carries 34% of global cases, yet studies to understand how the immune system reacts to dengue infection remain limited.
analysis.study_design_and_population: This study analyzed early transcriptional signatures from whole blood of 112 NS1 positive hospital-reported dengue patients and dissected biological processes linked to varying disease severities, with and without warning signs.
analysis.methods: Differential gene expression analysis was used to identify gene patterns associated with severe dengue infection, and weighted gene co-expression network analysis (WGCNA) was employed to link gene modules to clinical traits.
analysis.main_results: Differential gene expression analysis showed suppressed innate response in WS patients, with downregulated cytokines (CXCL8, CXCL16, CXCL2, IL1B) and disrupted platelet function. CTTN, involved in maintenance of vascular permeability, showed the highest significant association with low platelet count.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The study highlights the role of interferon response and inflammation in severe dengue outcomes, identifying key genes such as IFI44L, IFI35, OAS1, HERC6, and SAMDL9. It also emphasizes the importance of CTTN in vascular permeability and platelet count.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These findings may contribute to improving diagnostic and therapeutic strategies for severe dengue by identifying potential biomarkers and pathways involved in disease progression.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited to abstract-only evidence, and the results are based on a single cohort of patients. The evidence strength is moderate due to the lack of detailed statistical analysis and external validation.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates the immune response to dengue infection in India, focusing on the transcriptional signatures of 112 NS1 positive patients. Using differential gene expression and WGCNA, it identifies suppressed innate responses and disrupted platelet function in severe cases. Key genes like IFI44L and CTTN are highlighted for their potential roles in disease severity. The findings may inform improved diagnostic and therapeutic approaches for severe dengue. However, the study is based on abstract-only data, limiting the confidence in its conclusions to a moderate level.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在了解免疫应答病毒对登革病毒感染的反应,并识别可能导致严重疾病的潜在临床生物标志物。印度占全球病例的34%,但关于登革病毒感染如何引发免疫应答的研究仍较为有限。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究分析了112例医院报告的NS1阳性登革热患者的全血早期转录组特征,并解析了与不同疾病严重程度相关的生物过程,包括有(WS)和无(-WS)预警信号的情况。
elements_zh.methods: 采用差异基因表达分析来识别与重症登革热感染相关的基因模式,并利用加权基因共表达网络分析(WGCNA)将基因模块与临床特征联系起来。
elements_zh.main_results: 差异基因表达分析显示,WS患者的先天免疫应答受到抑制,细胞因子(CXCL8、CXCL16、CXCL2、IL1B)下调,血小板功能紊乱。参与维持血管通透性的CTTN基因与低血小板计数显示出最高显著关联。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 本研究突出了干扰素反应和炎症在重症登革热感染结果中的作用,识别了关键基因如IFI44L、IFI35、OAS1、HERC6和SAMDL9。同时强调了CTTN在血管通透性和血小板计数中的重要性。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可能有助于通过识别疾病进展中涉及的潜在生物标志物和通路,改善重症登革热的诊断和治疗策略。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究仅基于摘要证据,结果基于单一队列研究患者队列。由于缺乏详细的统计分析和外部验证,证据强度中等。

papers.abstract_zh: 目的 登革病毒病毒具有四个血清型(DENV 1-4),通过Aedes aegypti传播。印度占全球病例的34%,但关于登革病毒感染如何引发免疫应答的研究仍较为有限。设计 本研究分析了112例医院报告的NS1阳性登革热患者的全血早期转录组特征,并解析了与不同疾病严重程度相关的生物过程,包括有(WS)和无(-WS)预警信号的情况。结果 差异基因表达分析显示,WS患者的先天免疫应答受到抑制,细胞因子(CXCL8、CXCL16、CXCL2、IL1B)下调,血小板功能紊乱。与之相反,与糖基化、神经系统和代谢相关的基因表达上调。WGCNA模块-表型分析发现,干扰素反应和炎症与血小板计数呈正相关,突出了关键基因IFI44L、IFI35、OAS1、HERC6和SAMDL9在相对严重疾病结果中的作用。参与维持血管通透性的CTTN基因与低血小板计数显示出最高显著关联。IFI44L成为显著标志物,其在血小板计数低于100 × 10ˆ9/L的患者与血小板计数在100-140 × 10ˆ9/L之间的患者之间表现出最高的转录计数差异。结论 本研究推进了对登革病毒感染的理解,并在感染初期识别了可能的临床生物标志物。这些发现可能有助于改善登革病毒感染的诊断和治疗策略。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在了解免疫应答病毒对登革病毒感染的反应,并识别可能导致严重疾病的潜在临床生物标志物。印度占全球病例的34%,但关于登革病毒感染如何引发免疫应答的研究仍较为有限。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究分析了112例医院报告的NS1阳性登革热患者的全血早期转录组特征,并解析了与不同疾病严重程度相关的生物过程,包括有(WS)和无(-WS)预警信号的情况。
analysis_zh.methods: 采用差异基因表达分析来识别与重症登革热感染相关的基因模式,并利用加权基因共表达网络分析(WGCNA)将基因模块与临床特征联系起来。
analysis_zh.main_results: 差异基因表达分析显示,WS患者的先天免疫应答受到抑制,细胞因子(CXCL8、CXCL16、CXCL2、IL1B)下调,血小板功能紊乱。参与维持血管通透性的CTTN基因与低血小板计数显示出最高显著关联。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 本研究突出了干扰素反应和炎症在重症登革热感染结果中的作用,识别了关键基因如IFI44L、IFI35、OAS1、HERC6和SAMDL9。同时强调了CTTN在血管通透性和血小板计数中的重要性。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可能有助于通过识别疾病进展中涉及的潜在生物标志物和通路,改善重症登革热的诊断和治疗策略。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究仅基于摘要证据,结果基于单一队列研究患者队列。由于缺乏详细的统计分析和外部验证,证据强度中等。

papers.title: Association of NS1 Antigen, IgM/IgG Antibodies with Haematological Indices and Inflammatory Markers in Suspected Dengue Cases: A Cross-sectional Study
papers.abstract: Introduction: Dengue Virus (DENV) has been re-emerging as a major public health challenge in tropical and subtropical regions, including India, with increasing incidence, changing epidemiology, and seasonal outbreaks. Early diagnosis supported by laboratory markers is essential for effective clinical management and disease control. Aim: To evaluate the association of serological markers with haematological, biochemical and inflammatory parameters in clinically suspected cases of dengue. Materials and Methods: This cross-sectional study was conducted from March 2025 to December 2025 at Adarsh Multispecialty Hospital, Gandhinagar, Gujarat, India. The study included 154 patients presenting with Acute Febrile Illness (AFI). DENV diagnosis was performed using an immunochromatographic kit for NS1 antigen and IgM and IgG antibodies from the serum sample. Haematological indices, Inflammation markers and liver function tests Serum Glutamic Pyruvic Transaminase (SGPT) and Serum Glutamic Oxaloacetic Transaminase (SGOT) were examined. Chi-square test was used for statistical analysis, and a p-value of <0.05 was considered statistically significant. Results: A total of 154 suspected Dengue Fever (DF) samples were collected, out of which 38 cases of dengue infection were confirmed. The highest positivity was seen in the age group of 21 to 30 years, 14 (36.8%), with males being more affected, making up 24 (63.2%) of the cases. The seasonal peaks happened during August and September, with 11/34 (32.4%) and 11/42 (26.2%) of cases, respectively. Testing for the NS1 antigen alone found 17/74 (23%) of infections, but combining NS1 and antibody testing raised the rate to about 20/73 (27.3%). Dengue patients showed significantly decreased platelet counts 35/38 (92.1%), White Blood Cell (WBC) counts 21/38 (55.26%), and also lymphocyte counts 20/38 (52.63%). Liver enzymes were also elevated (SGOT 161.58±372.44 U/L and SGPT 187.46±456.09 U/L). They also showed raised C-Reactive Protein (CRP) in 33/38 (86.8%) of cases and higher Erythrocyte Sedimentation Rate (ESR) in 23/38 (60.5%) of cases. Conclusion: Detection of the NS1 antigen with antibody testing gives more specific results. Significant increase in CRP levels and a drop in platelet levels in dengue-positive patients are early indicators of presumptive diagnosis. Integrated haematological, and inflammatory markers facilitate efficient risk stratification and enhance early dengue identification, enabling prompt clinical therapy during periods of peak transmission.
papers.journal: JOURNAL OF CLINICAL AND DIAGNOSTIC RESEARCH

analysis.summary_en: This cross-sectional study aimed to evaluate the association of serological markers with haematological, biochemical, and inflammatory parameters in clinically suspected dengue cases. Conducted at Adarsh Multispecialty Hospital in Gujarat, India, from March to December 2025, the study included 154 patients with acute febrile illness. DENV diagnosis was performed using an immunochromatographic kit for NS1 antigen and IgM/IgG antibodies. The results showed that 38 out of 154 samples were confirmed as dengue infections, with the highest positivity in the 21-30 age group and among males. Dengue patients exhibited significantly decreased platelet and white blood cell counts, elevated liver enzymes, and increased CRP and ESR levels. The authors concluded that combining NS1 antigen and antibody testing improves diagnostic specificity, and integrated haematological and inflammatory markers can aid in early identification and risk stratification. The study provides insights into the clinical and laboratory features of dengue infection, which may inform early diagnosis and management strategies during peak transmission periods.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 登革病毒(DENV)再次成为热带和亚热带地区,包括印度在内的主要公共卫生挑战,伴随着感染率的上升、流行特征的变化以及季节性暴发。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本横断面研究于2025年3月至12月在印度古吉拉特邦甘地纳加尔的Adarsh多专科医院进行。研究纳入了154名患有急性发热性疾病(AFI)的患者。
elements_zh.methods: 登革病毒检测通过免疫层析试剂盒对血清样本中的NS1抗原和IgM、IgG抗体进行。检测了血液学指标、炎症标志物以及肝功能测试,包括血清谷丙转氨酶(SGPT)和血清谷草转氨酶(SGOT)。采用卡方检验进行统计分析,p值<0.05被认为具有统计学意义。
elements_zh.main_results: 总共收集了154例疑似登革热(DF)样本,其中确诊登革病毒感染的病例有38例。21至30岁年龄组的阳性率最高,共14例(36.8%),男性患者更多,占病例的24例(63.2%)。单独检测NS1抗原发现17/74(23%)的感染,但结合NS1和抗体检测后,阳性率提高到约20/73(27.3%)。登革热患者表现出显著降低的血小板计数35/38(92.1%)、白细胞(WBC)计数21/38(55.26%)以及淋巴细胞计数20/38(52.63%)。肝酶水平也升高(SGOT 161.58±372.44 U/L和SGPT 187.46±456.09 U/L)。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: NS1抗原与抗体检测相结合可提供更具体的检测结果。整合血液学和炎症标志物有助于有效的风险分层,并增强早期登革热识别,从而在感染高峰期实现及时的临床治疗。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 登革热阳性患者中CRP水平显著升高和血小板水平下降是早期疑似感染的指标。

papers.title: The Evolution of Dengue Virus in India
papers.abstract: The evolution of dengue virus (DENV) is highly modulated by pathogen transmission bottlenecks and immunological pressures. These evolutionary events lead to mutations that cause antigenic changes and the replacement of DENV genotypes, which are directly correlated with epidemic magnitude and severe disease. India bears a disproportionately high dengue burden, accounting for nearly one-third of global cases, making it a persistent public health challenge. The periodic recurrence of outbreaks and cocirculation of all four serotypes pose challenges in disease control efforts. Nearly half of the country's population is seropositive for dengue, with varying seropositivity by age and geographical location. The spatiotemporal dynamics of prevalent serotypes in India are often associated with changes in transmission patterns, leading to cyclic outbreaks approximately every 2–3 years. Although multiple genotypes of serotypes have been recorded worldwide, Indian genotypes are highly diverged, with strong intermixing with neighboring countries. This review explores the mechanisms that drive DENV evolution underlying viral transmission bottlenecks, intrahost genetic diversity, and host immune responses. I also highlight the role of preexisting cross-reactive immunity and concurrent coinfections involving more than one serotype or other genetically similar arboviruses in the evolution of DENV. Finally, I outline the impact of DENV evolution on vaccine development and deployment in India.

analysis.scope_and_question: The review focuses on the evolution of dengue virus (DENV) in India, specifically examining how transmission bottlenecks and immunological pressures influence its genetic changes. The central question is how these evolutionary dynamics contribute to the emergence of new genotypes and the severity of dengue disease.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: The review is a narrative synthesis that explores the mechanisms driving DENV evolution, including viral transmission bottlenecks, intrahost genetic diversity, and host immune responses. It does not report on specific databases, search dates, or meta-analysis methods.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: Dengue virus evolution in India is driven by transmission bottlenecks and immunological pressures, leading to mutations that cause antigenic changes and genotype replacement. These changes are directly correlated with epidemic magnitude and severe disease outcomes.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The review notes that the periodic recurrence of outbreaks and cocirculation of all four serotypes present challenges in disease control. Additionally, the spatiotemporal dynamics of prevalent serotypes are linked to changes in transmission patterns, but the exact mechanisms remain unclear.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: The review emphasizes the need to understand the impact of DENV evolution on vaccine development and deployment in India. It also highlights the importance of monitoring seropositivity rates and transmission patterns to improve public health strategies.

analysis.summary_en: This review examines the evolution of dengue virus (DENV) in India, emphasizing the role of transmission bottlenecks and immunological pressures in driving genetic changes. It highlights how these changes lead to antigenic shifts and genotype replacement, which are associated with increased epidemic severity. The review also discusses the challenges posed by the periodic outbreaks and the cocirculation of all four DENV serotypes. It underscores the importance of understanding DENV evolution for vaccine development and public health interventions, particularly given India's high dengue burden. The review notes that while the spatiotemporal dynamics of DENV serotypes are linked to transmission patterns, the exact mechanisms remain unclear, creating a need for further research.

elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 印度登革病毒的系统发育受到传播瓶颈和免疫压力的驱动,导致抗原性变化和基因型替换。这些变化与疫情规模和严重疾病结果直接相关。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 综述指出,登革病毒暴发的周期性复发以及四种血清型的共循环给疾病控制带来了挑战。此外,流行血清型的时空动态与传播模式的变化相关,但具体机制仍不清楚。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 综述强调了理解DENV系统发育对印度疫苗开发和部署的影响的重要性。同时,它还突出了监测血清阳性率和传播模式以改进公共卫生策略的必要性。

analysis_zh.scope_and_question: 本综述聚焦于印度登革病毒(DENV)的系统发育,具体探讨传播瓶颈和免疫压力如何影响其遗传变化。核心问题是这些进化动态如何促进新基因型的出现和登革疾病的严重程度。
analysis_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 本综述是一项叙述性综合分析,探讨了驱动DENV系统发育的机制,包括病毒传播瓶颈、宿主内遗传多样性以及系统发育分析和系统发育特征。它并未报告特定数据库、检索日期或元分析方法。

papers.title: Insecticide Esistance Status, Mechanism and Control Measures of Dengue Vector Aedes aegypti: A Systematic Review
papers.abstract: Aedes aegypti is a primary vector responsible for transmitting several public health-threatening diseases, including dengue fever, urban yellow fever, chikungunya, and Zika virus. Vector control has traditionally relied heavily on various chemical insecticides; however, this prolonged and intensive use of synthetic chemicals has led to the development of insecticide resistance in mosquito populations. This review outlines the current status of resistance develops to key classes of chemical insecticides, including carbamates, organochlorines, organophosphates, and pyrethroids. Additionally, the review provides an in-depth explanation of the underlying mechanisms responsible for the resistance observed in Aedes mosquitoes in natural populations. Four main types of resistance mechanisms have been identified based on biochemical processes, including Altered target-site resistance, Metabolic resistance, Penetration resistance and Behavioral resistance. This study reveals that Aedes aegypti demonstrates the highest resistance to pyrethroids, especially permethrin and deltamethrin, yet remains comparatively susceptible to organophosphates, notably malathion and fenitrothion. Further research is necessary to address key knowledge gaps and support the development of effective alternatives to conventional insecticides. It is suggested to exploit the effectiveness of plant-based compounds, biological control agents, and sterile insect technique to control the Aedes aegypti population. J Bangladesh Agril Univ 24(3): 187–200, 2026

analysis.scope_and_question: This review focuses on the insecticide resistance status, mechanisms, and control measures of Aedes aegypti, the primary vector of dengue virus. The central question is to evaluate the current resistance trends and their implications for vector control strategies.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: The review is a systematic analysis of existing literature on insecticide resistance in Aedes aegypti. It includes studies on resistance mechanisms and control measures, with an emphasis on biochemical processes and practical interventions.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: The review concludes that Aedes aegypti has developed significant resistance to pyrethroids, particularly permethrin and deltamethrin, while remaining relatively susceptible to organophosphates such as malathion and fenitrothion. Four main resistance mechanisms are identified: Altered target-site resistance, Metabolic resistance, Penetration resistance, and Behavioral resistance.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The review highlights the need for further research to address knowledge gaps and develop effective alternatives to conventional insecticides. There is limited data on the effectiveness of newer control methods in different geographic regions and populations.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: The review suggests exploring plant-based compounds, biological control agents, and the sterile insect technique as potential alternatives to conventional insecticides for controlling Aedes aegypti populations. These methods could help mitigate the growing problem of insecticide resistance.

analysis.summary_en: This systematic review examines the insecticide resistance status, mechanisms, and control measures of Aedes aegypti, the primary vector of dengue virus. It highlights the increasing resistance to pyrethroids, particularly permethrin and deltamethrin, and identifies four main resistance mechanisms. The review emphasizes the need for further research and the exploration of alternative control strategies such as plant-based compounds, biological agents, and sterile insect techniques to address the growing challenge of insecticide resistance. The findings underscore the importance of developing new methods to effectively manage Aedes aegypti populations and reduce the transmission of dengue virus.

elements_en.evidence_base_and_review_method: The review is a systematic analysis of existing literature on insecticide resistance in Aedes aegypti. It includes studies on resistance mechanisms and control measures, with an emphasis on biochemical processes and practical interventions.
elements_en.consensus_and_key_conclusions: The review concludes that Aedes aegypti has developed significant resistance to pyrethroids, particularly permethrin and deltamethrin, while remaining relatively susceptible to organophosphates such as malathion and fenitrothion. Four main resistance mechanisms are identified: Altered target-site resistance, Metabolic resistance, Penetration resistance, and Behavioral resistance.
elements_en.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The review highlights the need for further research to address knowledge gaps and develop effective alternatives to conventional insecticides. There is limited data on the effectiveness of newer control methods in different geographic regions and populations.
elements_en.research_and_practice_implications: The review suggests exploring plant-based compounds, biological control agents, and the sterile insect technique as potential alternatives to conventional insecticides for controlling Aedes aegypti populations. These methods could help mitigate the growing problem of insecticide resistance.

elements_zh.scope_and_question: 本综述聚焦于埃及伊蚊的杀虫剂抗性状况、机制及控制措施,该蚊虫是登革病毒的主要媒介。核心问题是评估当前的抗性趋势及其对杀虫剂控制策略的影响。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 本综述是对埃及伊蚊杀虫剂抗性相关现有文献的系统分析,包括抗性机制和控制措施的研究,特别强调生化过程和实际干预措施。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 综述得出结论,埃及伊蚊已对拟除虫菊酯类杀虫剂产生显著抗性,尤其是氯氰菊酯和高效氯氰菊酯,而对有机磷类杀虫剂如马拉硫磷和敌敌畏仍相对敏感。已识别出四种主要抗性机制:靶点位点改变抗性、代谢抗性、穿透抗性和行为抗性。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 综述强调需要进一步研究以填补知识空白并开发有效的传统杀虫剂替代品。关于新控制方法在不同地理区域和种群中的效果数据有限。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 综述建议探索植物源化合物、生物控制剂和不育昆虫技术作为传统杀虫剂的潜在替代方法,以控制埃及伊蚊种群。这些方法可能有助于缓解日益严重的杀虫剂抗性问题。

papers.title_zh: 登革病毒媒介埃及伊蚊的杀虫剂抗性状况、机制及控制措施:系统综述
papers.source_body_en: Aedes aegypti is a primary vector responsible for transmitting several public health-threatening diseases, including dengue fever, urban yellow fever, chikungunya, and Zika virus. Vector control has traditionally relied heavily on various chemical insecticides; however, this prolonged and intensive use of synthetic chemicals has led to the development of insecticide resistance in mosquito populations. This review outlines the current status of resistance develops to key classes of chemical insecticides, including carbamates, organochlorines, organophosphates, and pyrethroids. Additionally, the review provides an in-depth explanation of the underlying mechanisms responsible for the resistance observed in Aedes mosquitoes in natural populations. Four main types of resistance mechanisms have been identified based on biochemical processes, including Altered target-site resistance, Metabolic resistance, Penetration resistance and Behavioral resistance. This study reveals that Aedes aegypti demonstrates the highest resistance to pyrethroids, especially permethrin and deltamethrin, yet remains comparatively susceptible to organophosphates, notably malathion and fenitrothion. Further research is necessary to address key knowledge gaps and support the development of effective alternatives to conventional insecticides. It is suggested to exploit the effectiveness of plant-based compounds, biological control agents, and sterile insect technique to control the Aedes aegypti population. papers.title: Assessment of the healthcare burden of dengue disease in England: a retrospective analysis (2010-2023).
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Dengue virus is transmitted by Aedes mosquitos, which are now prevalent in destinations commonly visited by UK travellers. Increased international travel and factors including climate change contribute to the global increase in dengue cases. Here, we evaluate the healthcare burden of dengue in England. METHODS: This retrospective, descriptive, cohort study (2010-2023) utilized data collected from National Health Service healthcare records in the Clinical Practice Research Datalink Aurum, linked with Hospital Episode Statistics, and Office for National Statistics mortality data. The primary objective was to determine the occurrence of hospitalized dengue. Other objectives were evaluation of healthcare resource utilization and costs, characteristics of hospitalized dengue cases, and complications due to dengue. Exploratory cohorts for suspected dengue in primary care were also reported. RESULTS: Data from Clinical Practice Research Datalink-linked records for 596 patients comprising the hospitalized dengue cohort were evaluated; the incidence rate of hospitalized dengue progressively increased from 2010 until the highest in 2019 (5.8 per million person-years); rates increased in 2022 after COVID-19 lockdowns. Approximately one-third of hospitalized dengue cases were aged 18-29 years, most were White or Asian, and the most common complication was gastrointestinal conditions (gastroenteritis/colitis; 34.7 cases per 1000 person-years). Healthcare costs in the year following hospitalized dengue cases were mostly driven by inpatient admission costs; ~20% of cases had a subsequent hospital admission (~50% were dengue-related). A total of 2286 suspected cases of dengue were reported in primary care, with 1066 unconfirmed and 1220 confirmed cases. CONCLUSIONS: Increasing incidence of dengue cases in England has followed global trends. The associated healthcare burden of imported dengue suggests a need for targeted public health strategies, particularly among younger travellers. Improvements in general practitioners' reporting of suspected dengue cases and associated details of symptoms and travel history are warranted.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to evaluate the healthcare burden of dengue in England from 2010 to 2023, addressing the increasing incidence of dengue cases following global trends.
analysis.study_design_and_population: A retrospective, descriptive, cohort study was conducted using data from National Health Service healthcare records, linked with Hospital Episode Statistics and Office for National Statistics mortality data, spanning from 2010 to 2023.
analysis.methods: Data were collected from the Clinical Practice Research Datalink Aurum, Hospital Episode Statistics, and Office for National Statistics mortality data, focusing on hospitalized dengue cases and suspected cases in primary care.
analysis.main_results: The incidence rate of hospitalized dengue increased progressively from 2010 to 2019, with the highest rate in 2019 (5.8 per million person-years). The rate increased again in 2022 after COVID-19 lockdowns. Approximately one-third of hospitalized dengue cases were aged 18-29 years, and the most common complication was gastrointestinal conditions. Healthcare costs were primarily driven by inpatient admission costs, with ~20% of cases having a subsequent hospital admission.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The study found that the increasing incidence of dengue cases in England aligns with global trends, highlighting the need for targeted public health strategies, particularly among younger travellers. Improvements in general practitioners' reporting of suspected dengue cases and associated details of symptoms and travel history are warranted.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings suggest a growing healthcare burden of imported dengue in England, indicating the importance of public health strategies to manage and prevent the disease, especially among younger travellers.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its retrospective nature and reliance on linked healthcare records, which may introduce biases. The sample size is adequate for trend analysis but may not be representative of the entire population. The study does not provide causal evidence and is descriptive in nature.

elements_en.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to evaluate the healthcare burden of dengue in England from 2010 to 2023, addressing the increasing incidence of dengue cases following global trends.
elements_en.study_design_and_population: A retrospective, descriptive, cohort study was conducted using data from National Health Service healthcare records, linked with Hospital Episode Statistics and Office for National Statistics mortality data, spanning from 2010 to 2023.
elements_en.methods: Data were collected from the Clinical Practice Research Datalink Aurum, Hospital Episode Statistics, and Office for National Statistics mortality data, focusing on hospitalized dengue cases and suspected cases in primary care.
elements_en.main_results: The incidence rate of hospitalized dengue increased progressively from 2010 to 2019, with the highest rate in 2019 (5.8 per million person-years). The rate increased again in 2022 after COVID-19 lockdowns. Approximately one-third of hospitalized dengue cases were aged 18-29 years, and the most common complication was gastrointestinal conditions. Healthcare costs were primarily driven by inpatient admission costs, with ~20% of cases having a subsequent hospital admission.
elements_en.interpretation_and_novelty: The study found that the increasing incidence of dengue cases in England aligns with global trends, highlighting the need for targeted public health strategies, particularly among younger travellers. Improvements in general practitioners' reporting of suspected dengue cases and associated details of symptoms and travel history are warranted.
elements_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings suggest a growing healthcare burden of imported dengue in England, indicating the importance of public health strategies to manage and prevent the disease, especially among younger travellers.
elements_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its retrospective nature and reliance on linked healthcare records, which may introduce biases. The sample size is adequate for trend analysis but may not be representative of the entire population. The study does not provide causal evidence and is descriptive in nature.

elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 该研究发现,英格兰登革热病例的增加趋势与全球趋势一致,突显了需要针对年轻旅行者的公共卫生策略。有必要改进全科医生对疑似登革热病例的报告以及相关症状和旅行史的详细信息。

papers.title_zh: 评估登革热在英格兰的医疗负担:一项回顾性分析(2010-2023年)
papers.source_body_en: BACKGROUND: Dengue virus is transmitted by Aedes mosquitos, which are now prevalent in destinations commonly visited by UK travellers. Increased international travel and factors including climate change contribute to the global increase in dengue cases. Here, we evaluate the healthcare burden of dengue in England. METHODS: This retrospective, descriptive, cohort study (2010-2023) utilized data collected from National Health Service healthcare records in the Clinical Practice Research Datalink Aurum, linked with Hospital Episode Statistics, and Office for National Statistics mortality data. The primary objective was to determine the occurrence of hospitalized dengue. Other objectives were evaluation of healthcare resource utilization and costs, characteristics of hospitalized dengue cases, and complications due to dengue. Exploratory cohorts for suspected dengue in primary care were also reported. RESULTS: Data from Clinical Practice Research Datalink-linked records for 596 patients comprising the hospitalized dengue cohort were evaluated; the incidence rate of hospitalized dengue progressively increased from 2010 until the highest in 2019 (5.8 per million person-years); rates increased in 2022 after COVID-19 lockdowns. Approximately one-third of hospitalized dengue cases were aged 18-29 years, most were White or Asian, and the most common complication was gastrointestinal conditions (gastroenteritis/colitis; 34.7 cases per 1000 person-years). Healthcare costs in the year following hospitalized dengue cases were mostly driven by inpatient admission costs; ~20% of cases had a subsequent hospital admission (~50% were dengue-related). A total of 2286 suspected cases of dengue were reported in primary care, with 1066 unconfirmed and 1220 confirmed cases. CONCLUSIONS: Increasing incidence of dengue cases in England has followed global trends. The associated healthcare burden of imported dengue suggests a need for targeted public health strategies, particularly among younger travellers. Improvements in general practitioners' reporting of suspected dengue cases and associated details of symptoms and travel history are warranted.

papers.title: Thiazolidine‐2,4‐dione and Thiazole Derivatives as Privileged Structures for Dengue Virus: A Review of Medicinal Chemistry Aspects
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Dengue fever is one of the greatest global health crises, with millions of infections annually and no effective antiviral therapy available. The high morbidity and mortality rate, combined with the rapid spread of the virus, highlights a critical failure in the fight against the disease. In this scenario, the search for new antiviral drugs is not only necessary, but urgent. Recently, thiazolidinedione (TZD) and thiazole derivatives have emerged as potential candidates for the treatment of dengue fever, challenging the paradigms of conventional therapies. These compounds represent a radically innovative approach by integrating direct antiviral activity—through selective inhibition of the NS2B‐NS3 protease and NS5 RNA polymerase—with the modulation of the inflammatory response, a key determinant in the progression of severe disease forms.The present study offers an in‐depth and innovative analysis of the therapeutic potential of these molecules, exploring in vitro and in silico assays and pharmacokinetic improvement strategies. The results reveal that TZDs and thiazoles have high affinity for strategic viral targets, effectively interrupting the DENV replication cycle and reducing the immunopathological effects of the infection. Unlike conventional antivirals, which fail to target a single mechanism of action, these molecules offer a multifunctional and disruptive approach, potentially redefining the treatment of dengue. By consolidating new therapeutic perspectives and providing a solid basis for future preclinical and clinical investigations, this study not only contributes to the advancement of biomedical science, but also represents a crucial milestone in the fight against one of the most neglected viruses in the world.
authors: Moacyr Jesus Barreto de Melo Rêgo

analysis.summary_en: This review focuses on the therapeutic potential of thiazolidinedione (TZD) and thiazole derivatives against dengue virus. It highlights the urgent need for effective antiviral therapies due to the high morbidity and mortality rates associated with dengue fever. The study explores the in vitro and in silico properties of these compounds, emphasizing their ability to inhibit key viral enzymes such as NS2B-NS3 protease and NS5 RNA polymerase, as well as modulate the inflammatory response. The findings suggest that these molecules could offer a multifunctional approach to treating dengue, potentially redefining current therapeutic strategies. However, the review notes the lack of established antiviral therapies and the need for further preclinical and clinical investigations to validate these promising results.

papers.source_body_en: ABSTRACT Dengue fever is one of the greatest global health crises, with millions of infections annually and no effective antiviral therapy available. These compounds represent a radically innovative approach by integrating direct antiviral activity—through selective inhibition of the NS2B‐NS3 protease and NS5 RNA polymerase—with the modulation of the inflammatory response, a key determinant in the progression of severe disease forms.The present study offers an in‐depth and innovative analysis of the therapeutic potential of these molecules, exploring in vitro and in silico assays and pharmacokinetic improvement strategies. The results reveal that TZDs and thiazoles have high affinity for strategic viral targets, effectively interrupting the DENV replication cycle and reducing the immunopathological effects of the infection. Unlike conventional antivirals, which fail to target a single mechanism of action, these molecules offer a multifunctional and disruptive approach, potentially redefining the treatment of dengue. papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 登革热是全球最大的健康危机之一,每年造成数百万例感染,且目前尚无有效的抗病毒药物疗法。高发病率和死亡率率,加上病毒的快速传播,凸显了在抗击该疾病过程中存在关键性的失败。在这种情况下,寻找新的抗病毒药物药物不仅必要,而且紧迫。最近,噻唑烷二酮(TZD)和噻唑衍生物被提出作为治疗的潜在候选药物,挑战了传统疗法的范式。这些化合物通过选择性抑制NS2B-NS3蛋白酶和NS5 RNA聚合酶,直接作用于抗病毒药物,同时调节免疫应答,这是严重疾病进展的关键决定因素。本研究提供了对这些分子治疗潜力的深入且创新的分析,探讨了体外和计算机模拟实验以及药代动力学改进策略。研究结果表明,TZDs和噻唑类化合物对关键病毒靶点具有高亲和力,能够有效中断DENV的复制周期,并减轻感染的免疫病理效应。与传统抗病毒药物药物不同,这些分子提供了一种多功能且具有破坏性的方法,可能重新定义登革热的治疗。通过整合新的治疗视角并为未来的临床前和临床研究提供坚实基础,本研究不仅推动了生物医学科学的发展,也标志着对抗全球最被忽视病毒之一的重要里程碑。

papers.title: Dengue Hemorrhagic Fever Case Prediction Using Climate and Social Media Data with Support Vector Regression
papers.abstract: Dengue hemorrhagic fever (DHF) remains a recurring public health problem in Surabaya, with transmission influenced by climatic variability and potentially reflected in social media activity. This study aims to develop an informatics-based model for predicting annual DHF cases by integrating climate and Twitter/X data and comparing Support Vector Regression (SVR) with Ridge Regression. The dataset covers 2010–2024 and combines annual DHF case records, annual and seasonal climate indices from Juanda and Tanjung Perak stations, and 320 Indonesian-language tweets related to DHF in Surabaya. Social media data were transformed into annual tweet volume, negative-sentiment tweet volume, and mean sentiment score, while predictors were aligned using a one-year time lag. Model performance was evaluated using Leave-One-Out Cross-Validation for 2011–2024 based on MAE, RMSE, and R2. SVR achieved the best performance with an MAE of 386.31 cases, RMSE of 556.86 cases, and R2 of 0.0121, outperforming Ridge Regression with an MAE of 601.31, RMSE of 727.19, and R2 of −0.6846. These findings indicate that SVR better captures nonlinear relationships in multisource dengue data, although explanatory power remains limited by few annual observations and high feature dimensionality. This study demonstrates the potential of multisource data integration for data-driven dengue early warning systems.

papers.abstract_zh: 登革出血热(DHF)仍然是苏腊巴亚地区反复出现的公共卫生问题,其传播受气候变异的影响,并可能在社交媒体活动中有体现。本研究旨在开发一个基于信息学的模型,通过整合气候数据和Twitter/X数据,预测年度DHF病例,并将支持媒介回归(SVR)与岭回归进行比较。数据集涵盖2010年至2024年,结合了年度DHF病例记录、Juanda和Tanjung Perak站点的年度和季节性气候指数,以及与苏腊巴亚地区DHF相关的320条印尼语推文。社交媒体数据被转换为年度推文数量、负面情绪推文数量和平均情绪得分,同时预测变量使用一年时间滞后进行对齐。模型性能通过2011年至2024年的留一法交叉验证(Leave-One-Out Cross-Validation)进行评估,依据MAE、RMSE和R2指标。SVR在MAE为386.31例、RMSE为556.86例、R2为0.0121的情况下表现最佳,优于岭回归的MAE为601.31、RMSE为727.19和R2为−0.6846。这些发现表明,SVR在多源登革热数据中更好地捕捉了非线性关系,尽管其解释力仍受到年度观察数据较少和高特征维度的限制。本研究展示了多源数据整合在数据驱动的登革热早期预警系统中的潜力。

papers.title: Shared evidence, different recommendations: a comparative analysis of Qdenga (TAK-003) dengue vaccine guidance for travellers across countries.
papers.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Dengue is an increasingly important cause of illness in travellers, and Qdenga (TAK-003) is the first dengue vaccine incorporated into guidance for travellers in multiple countries. However, clinicians and travellers may encounter differing recommendations across jurisdictions. This study compared guidance on the use of Qdenga in travellers across countries. METHODS: We conducted a comparative analysis of national guidance on Qdenga use for travellers across countries, using survey data and structured review of publicly available recommendations. Guidance was synthesized according to dengue immune status and mapped across recurring decision domains. RESULTS: Survey responses were obtained from 18 advisory bodies across 17 countries between March and April 2026, including 12 non-endemic countries where Qdenga was licensed and guidance published. Guidance was generally more restrictive than regulatory authorization. While there was broad agreement in recommending vaccination for travellers with laboratory-confirmed prior dengue infection, recommendations for those without documented infection varied widely. All advisory bodies considered destination-specific dengue risk but differed in whether and how they used travel duration, repeated or cumulative exposure, traveller characteristics and host susceptibility factors to determine vaccine eligibility. Some recommendations restricted vaccination to travellers with prior dengue infection, whereas others extended eligibility to selected travellers without documented prior infection or recommended vaccination based on exposure risk, irrespective of serostatus. Approaches also differed in assessment of prior dengue infection and whether completion of the two-dose series before travel was required. CONCLUSIONS: Variation in Qdenga guidance reflects differences in how advisory bodies interpret shared evidence and manage uncertainty arising from data gaps and differences between trial populations and travellers. Additional data on vaccine effectiveness and clinical outcomes among seronegative travellers and older adults may help reduce uncertainty and support greater alignment of future recommendations. Regardless, transparency and shared clinical decision-making remain essential when discussing dengue vaccination with travellers.

analysis.summary_en: This review article compares dengue vaccine guidance for travellers across countries, focusing on the Qdenga (TAK-003) vaccine. It highlights variations in recommendations based on dengue immune status and other factors, despite shared evidence. The study found broad agreement on vaccinating travellers with prior dengue infection but significant differences for those without documented infection. Advisory bodies considered destination-specific risk but varied in their use of travel duration, exposure, and host factors. The article emphasizes the need for transparency and shared decision-making, and suggests that additional data on vaccine effectiveness among seronegative travellers and older adults could reduce uncertainty and align future recommendations.

elements_zh.scope_and_question: 本研究比较了各国关于Qdenga(TAK-003)登革热疫苗使用指南的差异,重点关注基于登革热免疫状态和其他因素的建议差异。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 该审查对多个国家关于Qdenga用于旅行者指南进行了比较分析,利用调查数据和公开可用指南的结构化审查。根据登革热免疫状态对指南进行了综合,并映射到反复出现的决策领域。

elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: Qdenga指南的差异反映了咨询机构在解释共享证据和处理因数据缺口及试验人群与旅行者之间的差异而产生的不确定性时的不同方式。关于疫苗在血清阴性旅行者和老年人中的有效性及临床结果的额外数据可能有助于减少不确定性,并支持未来建议的更大一致性。

papers.title_zh: 共享证据,不同建议:对Qdenga(TAK-003)登革热疫苗指南中旅行者跨国家建议的比较分析。
papers.source_body_en: INTRODUCTION: Dengue is an increasingly important cause of illness in travellers, and Qdenga (TAK-003) is the first dengue vaccine incorporated into guidance for travellers in multiple countries. However, clinicians and travellers may encounter differing recommendations across jurisdictions. This study compared guidance on the use of Qdenga in travellers across countries. METHODS: We conducted a comparative analysis of national guidance on Qdenga use for travellers across countries, using survey data and structured review of publicly available recommendations. Guidance was synthesized according to dengue immune status and mapped across recurring decision domains. RESULTS: Survey responses were obtained from 18 advisory bodies across 17 countries between March and April 2026, including 12 non-endemic countries where Qdenga was licensed and guidance published. Guidance was generally more restrictive than regulatory authorization. While there was broad agreement in recommending vaccination for travellers with laboratory-confirmed prior dengue infection, recommendations for those without documented infection varied widely. All advisory bodies considered destination-specific dengue risk but differed in whether and how they used travel duration, repeated or cumulative exposure, traveller characteristics and host susceptibility factors to determine vaccine eligibility. Some recommendations restricted vaccination to travellers with prior dengue infection, whereas others extended eligibility to selected travellers without documented prior infection or recommended vaccination based on exposure risk, irrespective of serostatus. Approaches also differed in assessment of prior dengue infection and whether completion of the two-dose series before travel was required. CONCLUSIONS: Variation in Qdenga guidance reflects differences in how advisory bodies interpret shared evidence and manage uncertainty arising from data gaps and differences between trial populations and travellers. Additional data on vaccine effectiveness and clinical outcomes among seronegative travellers and older adults may help reduce uncertainty and support greater alignment of future recommendations. Regardless, transparency and shared clinical decision-making remain essential when discussing dengue vaccination with travellers.
papers.abstract_zh: 引言:登革热正成为旅行者疾病的一个日益重要的原因,而Qdenga(TAK-003)是首个被纳入多个国家旅行者指南的登革热疫苗。然而,临床医生和旅行者可能在不同司法管辖区遇到不同的建议。本研究比较了各国对Qdenga在旅行者中使用指南的差异。方法:我们对多个国家关于Qdenga用于旅行者指南进行了比较分析,利用调查数据和公开可用指南的结构化审查。根据登革热免疫状态对指南进行了综合,并映射到反复出现的决策领域。结果:2026年3月至4月期间,从17个国家的18个咨询机构获得了调查回复,包括12个非疫区国家,这些国家已批准Qdenga并发布了指南。指南通常比监管授权更为严格。尽管在推荐疫苗接种给有实验室确认既往登革热感染的旅行者方面存在广泛共识,但对无既往感染记录的旅行者推荐则差异较大。所有咨询机构都考虑了目的地特定的登革热风险,但在是否以及如何使用旅行时长、重复或累积暴露、旅行者特征和宿主易感因素来决定疫苗资格方面存在差异。一些指南仅将疫苗接种推荐给有既往登革热感染的旅行者,而另一些则扩展资格至部分无既往感染记录的旅行者,或根据暴露风险推荐疫苗接种,而不论血清状态。在评估既往登革热感染以及是否需要在旅行前完成两剂系列接种方面也存在不同方法。结论:Qdenga指南的差异反映了咨询机构在解释共享证据和处理因数据缺口及试验人群与旅行者之间的差异而产生的不确定性时的不同方式。关于疫苗在血清阴性旅行者和老年人中的有效性及临床结果的额外数据可能有助于减少不确定性,并支持未来建议的更大一致性。无论如何,透明度和共享的临床决策仍然是与旅行者讨论登革热疫苗接种时的关键要素。

papers.title: Dengue virus 2 lacking N153 glycosylation displayed enhanced recognition by neutralizing antibodies
papers.abstract: Abstract Deglycosylated (N153Q) dengue virus (DENV) mutant shows attenuated infection in a mouse model, mainly due to its increased antibody susceptibility. This is consistent with the neutralization assay showing human monoclonal antibodies 2D22 and C10 are more potent towards the mutant than the wild-type (WT) virus. Here, we compared the cryoEM structures of WT and mutant viruses complexed with these Fabs at 37 °C (2.7–3.2 Å resolution). We observed increased occupancies for both Fabs on the mutant virus, suggesting higher accessibility of epitopes that were previously blocked by glycosylation. Using biolayer interferometry, we showed that at 30 °C, the antibodies exhibited a slower binding rate with the mutant than with WT virus, along with a slower dissociation rate. analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to investigate how the absence of N153 glycosylation in dengue virus 2 affects its recognition by neutralizing antibodies. This is important for understanding potential vaccine targets.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study used a mouse model to compare the infection dynamics of the N153Q dengue virus 2 mutant with the wild-type virus. The research was conducted in an abstract-only format, focusing on structural and functional analyses.
analysis.methods: The researchers compared cryoEM structures of wild-type and mutant viruses complexed with human monoclonal antibodies 2D22 and C10. They also performed biolayer interferometry to assess antibody binding kinetics at different temperatures.
analysis.main_results: The N153Q mutant showed increased antibody occupancy, indicating higher epitope accessibility. At 30 °C, antibodies bound more slowly to the mutant, but at 37 °C, their affinities for both wild-type and mutant viruses increased significantly.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings suggest that the N153Q mutation enhances antibody recognition, which could be beneficial for vaccine development. This is a novel observation regarding the impact of glycosylation on antibody binding dynamics.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These results provide insights into how glycosylation modifications can influence antibody neutralization, which may inform the design of more effective dengue vaccines.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is based on abstract-only evidence, which limits the depth of analysis. However, the findings are supported by structural and kinetic data, providing moderate confidence in their interpretation.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates how the absence of N153 glycosylation in dengue virus 2 affects its recognition by neutralizing antibodies. Using cryoEM and biolayer interferometry, the researchers found that the N153Q mutant showed increased antibody occupancy and binding affinity at 37 °C compared to the wild-type virus. These results suggest that the mutation enhances epitope accessibility, potentially making the mutant a good vaccine candidate. The study is based on abstract-only evidence, which limits the depth of analysis but supports moderate confidence in the findings. The findings may inform the development of more effective dengue vaccines by highlighting the role of glycosylation in antibody neutralization.

papers.title: Examining Dengue-related Information Diffusion on Indonesian Twitter Through Sentiment-based Network Analysis, Spatial Mapping, and Temporal Dynamics
papers.abstract: Dengue fever remains a major public health challenge in Indonesia, yet studies integrating sentiment analysis, Social Network Analysis, and spatial analysis to examine dengue-related information diffusion on social media remain limited.This study proposes an integrated framework applied to 5,715 dengue-related tweets collected from Indonesian Twitter between January 2021 and December 2025.Sentiment classification using IndoBERT revealed a predominantly neutral discourse (65.23%), with meaningful negative (20.31%) and positive (14.45%) proportions.Sentiment-weighted interaction networks were constructed and analysed, revealing highly fragmented structures with modularity scores exceeding 0.98.Healthcare professionals emerged as the most robustly influential actors by betweenness centrality, with PageRank-based influence conditional on self-loop treatment, while the Ministry of Health held the highest in-degree values.Spatial analysis, based primarily on self-reported user locations, indicated geographic concentration along the Java-Bali corridor, and temporal analysis revealed recurring peaks in January and June aligned with Indonesia's wet season and dengue outbreak cycles.These findings demonstrate the value of integrating sentiment, network, and spatial dimensions for comprehensive public health communication analysis.

Revised: July 16, 2026. 685 International Journal of Intelligent Engineering and Systems, Vol.19, No.9, 2026 DOI: 10.22266/ijies2026.0930.35 This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 International License. License details: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/ Examining Dengue-related Information Diffusion on Indonesian Twitter Through Sentiment-based Network Analysis, Spatial Mapping, and Temporal Dynamics Ribka Devina Margaretha1 Wiwik Anggraeni1* 1Department of Information Systems, Institut Teknologi Sepuluh Nopember, Surabaya, Indonesia * Corresponding author’s Email: wiwik@is.its.ac.id Abstract: Dengue fever remains a major public health challenge in Indonesia, yet studies integrating sentiment analysis, Social Network Analysis, and spatial analysis to examine dengue-related information diffusion on social media remain limited. This study proposes an integrated framework applied to 5,715 dengue-related tweets collected from Indonesian Twitter between January 2021 and December 2025. Sentiment classification using IndoBERT revealed a predominantly neutral discourse (65.23%), with meaningful negative (20.31%) and positive (14.45%) proportions. Sentiment-weighted interaction networks were constructed and analysed, revealing highly fragmented structures with modularity scores exceeding 0.98. Healthcare professionals emerged as the most robustly influential actors by betweenness centrality, with PageRank-based influence conditional on self-loop treatment, while the Ministry of Health held the highest in-degree values. Spatial analysis, based primarily on self-reported user locations, indicated geographic concentration along the Java-Bali corridor, and temporal analysis revealed recurring peaks in January and June aligned with Indonesia's wet season and dengue outbreak cycles. These findings demonstrate the value of integrating sentiment, network, and spatial dimensions for comprehensive public health communication analysis. Keywords: Dengue fever, Sentiment-based network analysis, Spatial analysis, Temporal analysis, Social media. 1. Introduction Dengue fever remains one of the fastest- spreading vector-borne diseases and a major global public health challenge, endemic in more than 100 countries and threatening approximately 3.9 billion people, particularly in Southeast Asia and Latin America [1-3]. In Indonesia, dengue is highly endemic and continues to cause serious health problems, with more than 257,000 reported cases and over 1,400 deaths in 2024 [4]. The increasing spread of dengue, driven by climate change, urbanisation, and population growth, has also heightened public concern regarding outbreaks and prevention efforts [5]. The growing use of social media, particularly Twitter, has created new opportunities to observe public responses and information exchange related to disease outbreaks[6-8]. Through mentions, replies, and reposts, Twitter enables rapid information diffusion across communities, while certain accounts play disproportionately influential roles in shaping discussions [9]. Social Network Analysis (SNA) has therefore been widely applied to identify influential actors and examine information diffusion dynamics within online networks [10, 11]. Beyond interaction patterns, social media discussions also reflect public opinions and emotional responses toward ongoing health issues [12]. Sentiment analysis provides a complementary approach for capturing these perceptions, and incorporating sentiment information into network analysis can deepen understanding of how dengue- related discussions propagate and evolve on social media [13]. Dengue burden and public health responses are not uniformly distributed across Indonesia, with substantial disparities observed across provinces and Received: June 15, 2026. Revised: July 16, 2026. 686 International Journal of Intelligent Engineering and Systems, Vol.19, No.9, 2026 DOI: 10.22266/ijies2026.0930.35 This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 International License. License details: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/ regions due to differences in population density, climate conditions, healthcare accessibility, and vector control capacity [14, 15]. Public perceptions and responses to health information also vary across communities due to cultural and social differences [16]. These regional variations highlight the importance of incorporating spatial information to better understand geographic differences in dengue- related discussions, public sentiment, and information dissemination patterns. Previous studies have applied SNA to identify influential users and examine information diffusion in online discussions, while sentiment analysis has been widely used to understand public perceptions toward health-related issues, and spatial analysis has been employed to reveal geographic variations in dengue transmission and public health responses. However, these approaches are typically investigated in isolation, limiting a comprehensive understanding of how interaction structures, public sentiment, and geographic context collectively shape online discussions. Studies integrating sentiment-weighted social networks with spatial analysis to examine dengue-related information diffusion on Indonesian Twitter remain particularly limited, highlighting the need for a more integrated analytical framework. To address this gap, this study integrates sentiment analysis, SNA, and spatial analysis to examine dengue-related Twitter discussions, constructing sentiment-weighted interaction networks and analysing them alongside geographic and temporal dimensions. The specific contributions of this study are: • Analysis of the spatial distribution of discussions and sentiments across Indonesian cities • Construction of sentiment-based interaction networks capturing both communication structure and public perception • Identification of national-level influential users using PageRank, degree centrality, and betweenness centrality • Identification of regional influential users across multiple Indonesian cities • Analysis of temporal discussion patterns and sentiment dynamics • Visualisation of interaction networks illustrating information diffusion structures. The remainder of this paper is structured as follows. Section 2 reviews related literature. Section 3 describes the data and methodology. Section 4 presents the results and discussion. Section 5 summarises the findings and outlines future directions. 2. Related works 2.1 Social network analysis for information diffusion SNA has been widely applied to investigate information diffusion and interaction patterns in online social networks, modelling users as nodes and interactions as edges to identify influential actors and community structures [17]. Various approaches have been proposed for influencer detection, including the NetDegree centrality measure and the Weighted Correlated Influence (WCI) model combining user activity and network topology [18, 19]. SNA has also been applied to explore community structures and communication dynamics in domain-specific discussions [20]. In health-related contexts, SNA has been used to identify key influencers, dominant topics, and communication structures shaping public awareness [10, 11, 21]. However, most existing health-related SNA studies focus on network topology and influencer identification without incorporating sentiment context or geographic variation. Bonifazi et al. identified influential users in COVID-19 vaccine Twitter discourse through a multilayer network approach, but did not construct sentiment-segmented networks or examine geographic distributions [21]. Durmaz and Hengirmen applied SNA to vaccine- related Twitter discourse in Turkey using in-degree and betweenness centrality, but did not integrate sentiment labels or examine spatial distributions [22]. Pratiwi et al. combined SNA and sentiment analysis for asthma-related Twitter discourse, but did not link findings to geographic distributions or construct sentiment-segmented networks [10]. The absence of sentiment integration and spatial context in these studies limits the depth of understanding achievable in health-related discourse analysis. 2.2 Sentiment analysis in social media discussions Sentiment analysis is widely applied to understand public opinions in social media, with recent studies demonstrating the effectiveness of advanced language models including IndoBERT for Indonesian-language content [23, 24]. Ishfaq et al. and Eliacik and Erdogan have incorporated sentiment into network-based analyses for influential user identification [25, 26]. However, applications combining sentiment and network characteristics in health-related discussions remain limited. Dengue-specific sentiment studies such as Abdul Ghani et al. demonstrate the value of sentiment for disease surveillance but do not Received: June 15, 2026. Revised: July 16, 2026. 687 International Journal of Intelligent Engineering and Systems, Vol.19, No.9, 2026 DOI: 10.22266/ijies2026.0930.35 This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 International License. License details: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/ construct interaction networks or link findings to geographic distributions [27]. Indonesian-language classification studies such as Supriyadi and Makatita and Nabiilah et al. demonstrate strong model performance without connecting findings to network structures or spatial patterns [23, 24]. While Ishfaq et al. and Eliacik and Erdogan incorporate sentiment into network analyses, neither examined dengue- related discourse or linked findings to spatial distributions [25, 26]. No prior study has simultaneously applied sentiment-integrated SNA to dengue-related Indonesian Twitter data, leaving a gap in understanding how emotional responses and interaction structures collectively shape dengue information diffusion. 2.3 Spatial analysis in health-related studies Spatial analysis has gained increasing attention in public health and social media research for understanding geographic variations in behaviour and information dissemination. Lovera and Cardinale demonstrated that geolocation enriches the interpretation of social media discussions [34]. Similarly, Wu et al. highlighted the value of geospatial enrichment for understanding large-scale sentiment behaviour[35]. In health-related contexts, Lin et al. revealed linguistic and geographic disparities in COVID-19 public awareness through social media, while Zhang et al. applied geographical and temporal analysis to health-related tweets to identify spatiotemporal disease discussion patterns at regional level [36, 37]. However, these studies focus on geographic distribution patterns without modelling user interaction networks or identifying regional-level influential users. Lin et al., Zhang et al., Lovera and Cardinale, and Wu et al. all incorporate geolocation into social media analysis, but do not construct interaction networks, identify influential users, or examine how sentiment varies across network communities [z-37]. Studies applying spatial analysis to dengue-related social media discourse, such as Abdul Ghani et al., have similarly focused on geographic mapping without modelling user interaction dynamics or examining sentiment- segmented network structures [27]. The absence of interaction network modelling and sentiment integration limits understanding of how network dynamics and public sentiment collectively shape dengue information diffusion. 2.4 Research gap Despite the established contributions of SNA, sentiment analysis, and spatial analysis individually, existing health-related social media studies address these dimensions in isolation, as demonstrated across Sections 2.1 to 2.3, focusing on network topology without sentiment context [10, 21, 22], applying sentiment classification without network or spatial linkage[23, 27], or examining geographic patterns without modelling interaction dynamics [34-37]. While sentiment analysis and network approaches have each been applied to health-related social media discourse individually, their simultaneous integration with spatial analysis in the specific context of dengue-related Indonesian Twitter data remains unexplored. No prior study has proposed a unified framework simultaneously capturing the structural, emotional, and geographic dimensions of dengue-related information diffusion on Indonesian Twitter. This study addresses that gap by integrating sentiment analysis, SNA, and spatial analysis within a single framework, constructing sentiment- segmented interaction networks to examine how different emotional contexts shape network structure and influencer profiles, mapping discussion distributions and regional influencer patterns across Indonesian cities, and tracing temporal dynamics of both discussion volume and sentiment evolution over a five-year period. This integrated approach offers a more complete understanding of information dissemination patterns, influential users, and public perceptions across different locations and time periods than prior single-method studies have provided. 3. Materials and method 3.1 Dataset Dengue-related tweets were collected from Twitter (X) between January 2021 and December 2025 using the Scweet Python library with three keywords: "dbd" (dengue haemorrhagic fever acronym in Indonesian), "Aedes aegypti" (the dengue-carrying mosquito species), and "demam berdarah dengue" (dengue haemorrhagic fever). Data collection was conducted between 9-14 April 2026. The collected tweets span the period from January 2021 to December 2025, reflecting the full range of historical tweets retrievable through Scweet at the time of collection; Scweet retrieves historical tweets via browser automation rather than the official Twitter/X API, and collection completeness is therefore subject to the platform's search indexing and any rate-limiting constraints encountered during scraping. All tweets included in this study represent observed data retrieved directly through Scweet; no Received: June 15, 2026. License details: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/ projected, simulated, or placeholder records are included in the dataset or in any reported analysis. Collection was conducted as a series of discrete scraping sessions per keyword and sub-period, with no session returning a tweet count at or exceeding the configured retrieval limit (500-1,000 tweets, depending on keyword), indicating retrieval without truncation within each queried window. A completeness check was performed by examining the year-by-year distribution of collected tweets to confirm the absence of anomalous gaps or artificially uniform collection patterns; as detailed in Section 4.6.1, tweet volume varied organically across the five-year period, consistent with externally documented dengue activity patterns in Indonesia rather than indicating systematic data loss. Each tweet record contains textual content, publication date, user information, engagement statistics, and interaction attributes including mentions, replies, and reposts. The collected dataset serves as the primary source for all sentiment, network, spatial, and temporal analyses conducted in this study. 3.2 Method This study employs an integrated analytical framework consisting of data preprocessing, sentiment classification, network construction, community detection, spatial analysis, and temporal analysis. The overall research procedure is illustrated in Fig. 1. Figure. 1 Overall research procedure flowchart Received: June 15, 2026. License details: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/ 3.2.1. Data preprocessing The datasets collected from different periods were combined and filtered to retain only the attributes required for analysis, including tweet identifiers, usernames, tweet content, timestamps, language information, location attributes, and interaction metadata. User mentions and replies were extracted separately to support network construction. Duplicate tweets and records with missing values in essential attributes were removed, and tweet texts were cleaned through lowercasing, URL removal, mention and hashtag removal, number and punctuation removal, and whitespace normalisation. Tweets that became empty after cleaning were discarded, and only Indonesian-language tweets were retained. Examples of tweets before and after preprocessing are shown in Table 1. For spatial analysis, location information was obtained from tweet-level and user profile locations, with the latter used as a fallback when tweet-level location was unavailable. Location texts were normalised and matched against a reference dataset of Indonesian cities, with common aliases and abbreviations standardised to improve matching accuracy. This process successfully mapped 3,327 tweets (58.22%) to 168 Indonesian cities. 3.2.2. papers.abstract_original: Dengue fever remains a major public health challenge in Indonesia, yet studies integrating sentiment analysis, Social Network Analysis, and spatial analysis to examine dengue-related information diffusion on social media remain limited.This study proposes an integrated framework applied to 5,715 dengue-related tweets collected from Indonesian Twitter between January 2021 and December 2025.Sentiment classification using IndoBERT revealed a predominantly neutral discourse (65.23%), with meaningful negative (20.31%) and positive (14.45%) proportions.Sentiment-weighted interaction networks were constructed and analysed, revealing highly fragmented structures with modularity scores exceeding 0.98.Healthcare professionals emerged as the most robustly influential actors by betweenness centrality, with PageRank-based influence conditional on self-loop treatment, while the Ministry of Health held the highest in-degree values.Spatial analysis, based primarily on self-reported user locations, indicated geographic concentration along the Java-Bali corridor, and temporal analysis revealed recurring peaks in January and June aligned with Indonesia's wet season and dengue outbreak cycles.These findings demonstrate the value of integrating sentiment, network, and spatial dimensions for comprehensive public health communication analysis.

papers.title: Temporal trends in dengue incidence and mortality across surveillance case classifications: a 13-year analysis from Davao City, Philippines
papers.abstract: Introduction Dengue remains a major public health concern in the Philippines, where routine surveillance systems classify reported cases as suspected, probable or confirmed. Although these classifications are widely used to monitor disease burden, their influence on the interpretation of long-term epidemiological trends and mortality patterns remains unclear. This study examined the temporal trends in dengue incidence and mortality across surveillance case classifications in Davao City, Philippines, over a 13-year period. Methods A retrospective observational study was conducted using dengue surveillance data collected from the Philippine Integrated Disease Surveillance and Response (PIDSR) system from January 2012 to December 2024. Reported dengue cases were classified as suspected, probable, or confirmed, according to the national surveillance definitions. elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 登革热仍然是菲律宾的主要公共卫生问题,其中常规的监测系统将报告的病例分为疑似、可能和确认三类。尽管这些分类被广泛用于监测疾病负担,但它们对长期流行病学趋势和死亡率模式的解释影响尚不明确。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究分析了菲律宾达瓦奥市在13年期间,登革热发病率和死亡率在监测病例分类中的时间趋势。采用回顾性观察设计,使用菲律宾集成疾病监测和响应(PIDSR)系统从2012年1月至2024年12月收集的登革热监测数据。研究期间共报告了81,075例登革热病例,包括59,021例疑似病例、20,559例可能病例和1,495例确认病例。
elements_zh.methods: Annual dengue incidence and mortality were calculated per 100,000 population, and temporal trends were assessed using the Mann–Kendall trend test. Reported dengue cases were classified as suspected, probable, or confirmed, according to the national surveillance definitions.
elements_zh.main_results: 确认的登革热发病率显示出随时间显著上升的趋势(p = 0.003),而可能(p = 0.855)和疑似登革热发病率(p = 0.059)则未显示出统计学上显著的时间趋势。登革热死亡率在疑似(p = 0.089)、可能(p = 0.242)和确认病例(p = 0.282)中均未显示出显著的时间趋势。在报告的登革热病例中,大多数死亡病例发生在可能和疑似病例中,而可能病例的最高累积病例死亡率(0.89%)被观察到。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 监测分类捕捉了登革热发病率和死亡率不同的流行病学模式。确认的登革热发病率上升趋势在国会选区、年龄组和性别中均一致观察到。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 在低收入和中等收入国家(LMIC)中,由于监测系统在诊断确定性方面存在不同水平,考虑可能和疑似病例分类可能提供超出实验室确认病例所获得的额外见解,以理解监测趋势和死亡率模式。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 提供的证据未报告研究设计的局限性或证据强度评估。

analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 监测分类捕捉了登革热发病率和死亡率不同的流行病学模式。确认的登革热发病率上升趋势在国会选区、年龄组和性别中均一致观察到。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 在低收入和中等收入国家(LMIC)中,由于监测系统在诊断确定性方面存在不同水平,考虑可能和疑似病例分类可能提供超出实验室确认病例所获得的额外见解,以理解监测趋势和死亡率模式。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 提供的证据未报告研究设计的局限性或证据强度评估。

papers.title: Relationship between Knowledge and Attitudes in the Community with Dengue Fever Preventive Behavior in Landasan Ulin Utara Village
papers.abstract: Background: The incidence of dengue fever in Landasan Ulin Utara Village remains high, with an outbreak status. The elevated case incidence may be attributed to insufficient community knowledge and awareness, ultimately contributing to inadequate dengue prevention behaviors. Objectives: Analyze the relationship between community knowledge and attitudes and dengue fever prevention behaviors in Landasan Ulin Utara Village. Methods: This cross-sectional study involved 164 heads of households or family members aged 15–64 years in Landasan Ulin Utara Village. Individual respondents were the unit of analysis. Data were collected using questionnaires and analyzed using Spearman’s rho test. Results: Based on the statistical test results, it was found that there was no correlation between community knowledge and attitudes and dengue fever prevention practices in Landasan Ulin Utara Village (p = 0.193; p = 0.150). Conclusion: There are several factors that can influence dengue prevention behavior among the community in Landasan Ulin Utara Village, including education level, experience, type of work, social environment, culture, media exposure, and emotional factors.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to investigate the relationship between community knowledge and attitudes and dengue fever preventive behaviors in Landasan Ulin Utara Village, where dengue incidence remains high and outbreak status is ongoing.
analysis.study_design_and_population: A cross-sectional study was conducted in Landasan Ulin Utara Village, involving 164 individuals aged 15–64 years, specifically heads of households or family members.
analysis.methods: Data were collected through questionnaires and analyzed using Spearman’s rho test to assess the correlation between knowledge and attitudes and dengue prevention behaviors.
analysis.main_results: The statistical analysis revealed no significant correlation between community knowledge and attitudes and dengue fever prevention practices in Landasan Ulin Utara Village (p = 0.193; p = 0.150).
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted the findings as indicating that factors other than knowledge and attitudes may influence dengue prevention behaviors, highlighting the need to explore additional determinants such as education level, experience, and social environment.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The results suggest that interventions targeting knowledge and attitudes alone may not be sufficient to improve dengue prevention behaviors, emphasizing the importance of addressing broader social and environmental factors.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its cross-sectional design, which cannot establish causality, and the lack of detailed analysis on potential confounding variables, resulting in moderate confidence in the findings.

analysis.summary_en: This study examines the relationship between community knowledge and attitudes and dengue fever preventive behaviors in Landasan Ulin Utara Village, where dengue incidence is high. A cross-sectional survey of 164 individuals aged 15–64 years was conducted using questionnaires, and Spearman’s rho test was employed to analyze the data. The results showed no significant correlation between knowledge and attitudes and prevention behaviors (p = 0.193; p = 0.150). The authors suggest that other factors, such as education level and social environment, may play a more significant role in shaping these behaviors. The findings highlight the need for a more comprehensive approach to dengue prevention, considering both individual and community-level determinants. However, the study's cross-sectional design limits its ability to establish causality, and the evidence is considered moderate in strength.

analysis_en.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to investigate the relationship between community knowledge and attitudes and dengue fever preventive behaviors in Landasan Ulin Utara Village, where dengue incidence remains high and outbreak status is ongoing.
analysis_en.study_design_and_population: A cross-sectional study was conducted in Landasan Ulin Utara Village, involving 164 individuals aged 15–64 years, specifically heads of households or family members.
analysis_en.methods: Data were collected through questionnaires and analyzed using Spearman’s rho test to assess the correlation between knowledge and attitudes and dengue prevention behaviors.
analysis_en.main_results: The statistical analysis revealed no significant correlation between community knowledge and attitudes and dengue fever prevention practices in Landasan Ulin Utara Village (p = 0.193; p = 0.150).
analysis_en.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted the findings as indicating that factors other than knowledge and attitudes may influence dengue prevention behaviors, highlighting the need to explore additional determinants such as education level, experience, and social environment.
analysis_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The results suggest that interventions targeting knowledge and attitudes alone may not be sufficient to improve dengue prevention behaviors, emphasizing the importance of addressing broader social and environmental factors.
analysis_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its cross-sectional design, which cannot establish causality, and the lack of detailed analysis on potential confounding variables, resulting in moderate confidence in the findings.

papers.title_zh: 兰达森乌林北村社区知识与态度与登革热预防行为的关系
papers.source_body_en: Background: The incidence of dengue fever in Landasan Ulin Utara Village remains high, with an outbreak status. The elevated case incidence may be attributed to insufficient community knowledge and awareness, ultimately contributing to inadequate dengue prevention behaviors. Objectives: Analyze the relationship between community knowledge and attitudes and dengue fever prevention behaviors in Landasan Ulin Utara Village. Methods: This cross-sectional study involved 164 heads of households or family members aged 15–64 years in Landasan Ulin Utara Village. Individual respondents were the unit of analysis. Data were collected using questionnaires and analyzed using Spearman’s rho test. Results: Based on the statistical test results, it was found that there was no correlation between community knowledge and attitudes and dengue fever prevention practices in Landasan Ulin Utara Village (p = 0.193; p = 0.150). Conclusion: There are several factors that can influence dengue prevention behavior among the community in Landasan Ulin Utara Village, including education level, experience, type of work, social environment, culture, media exposure, and emotional factors.

papers.title: Retrospective and Contemporary Genomic Surveillance Reveals Genotype-Specific Dengue Lineage Dynamics in Rio de Janeiro
papers.abstract: Dengue virus (DENV) transmission in Brazil is characterized by recurrent epidemics involving the introduction, persistence, and replacement of viral lineages. However, temporal gaps in genomic surveillance limit our understanding of how these processes shape successive epidemics in Rio de Janeiro. Here, in a retrospective observational molecular epidemiology study, we combined archived genomic data with publicly available sequences and epidemiological surveillance data to investigate the temporal dynamics of DENV serotypes and lineages in Rio de Janeiro. Archived DENV-positive samples were curated and subjected to whole-genome amplicon sequencing, and the resulting consensus sequences were analyzed together with publicly available sequences using time-scaled phylogenetic reconstruction and epidemiological data. We recovered 35 DENV genomes from samples collected in 2013, 2018, 2020, and 2021, including DENV-1 genotype V, DENV-2 genotypes II and III, and DENV-4 genotype II. Analysis of the combined datasets identified multiple Rio de Janeiro-associated clades with distinct temporal patterns. Publicly available sequences supported the broader clade structure and long-term temporal patterns independently of most genomes generated here. The newly generated genomes made genotype-specific contributions: the five DENV-1 genotype V genomes placed archived 2020–2021 samples within previously represented Rio de Janeiro-associated groups, while the single DENV-2 genotype II genome provided phylogenetic placement of a travel-associated 2018 case. In contrast, the 20 DENV-2 genotype III genomes identified a Rio de Janeiro-associated cluster not represented among the public sequences, and the nine DENV-4 genotype II genomes increased representation of the 2013 epidemic. Thus, the principal contribution of retrospective sequencing was to fill specific temporal and geographic gaps rather than to redefine the broader historical phylogenetic structure of all genotypes.

analysis_zh.main_results: 我们从2013年、2018年、2020年和2021年采集的样本中恢复了35个DENV 基因组,包括DENV-1基因型V、DENV-2基因型II和III以及DENV-4基因型II。对综合数据集的分析识别出多个与里约热内卢相关的谱系,具有不同的时间模式。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 公开可用的序列独立于此处生成的大多数基因组,支持了更广泛的谱系结构和长期时间模式。新生成的基因组在基因型层面做出了贡献:五个DENV-1基因型V 基因组将存档的2020–2021年样本置于之前已代表的里约热内卢相关群体中,而单个DENV-2基因型II 基因组则提供了与旅行相关的2018年病例的系统发育定位。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 相比之下,20个DENV-2基因型III 基因组识别出一个未在公开序列中出现的里约热内卢相关簇,而九个DENV-4基因型II 基因组则增加了2013年暴发的代表性。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 因此,回顾性测序的主要贡献在于填补特定的时间和地理空白,而不是重新定义所有基因型的更广泛历史系统发育结构。
